0x42b4ba.name: rotateMoveDirectionGrid
0x42b4ba.purpose: Builds a 2x2x3 grid of client-address globals to remap movement/step directions, then dispatches an action based on the direction byte passed in [ebp+8]. It reads two client fields via ReadClientState(sub_4011B8, size 4) from [0x4db372c] and [0x4db3728] (player X and Y mirrors) into base pointers, seeds a 9-entry local table with direction opcode constants 0x6d,0x65,0x6a,0x68,0x68,0x66,0x6c,0x67,0x6b (the 'e/f/g/h/j/k/l/m' walk-direction letters, i.e. the 0x65-0x6c walk opcode band), computes neighbor offsets with sub_401032 (address add helper), then for input opcode 0x66,0x68,0x65,0x67 (walk directions) selects a matching cell and calls sub_4011F4 to emit it. Effectively a direction-transposition/rotation lookup for the walk subsystem. Returns 1.

0x42cbd7.name: huntBotInit
0x42cbd7.purpose: HuntBot startup routine. Calls sub_401145 (subsystem init), clears run-state flags dword[0x4db38e4]=0 and sets dword[0x4db3838]=1 (bot enabled), calls sub_4013D9 (secondary init), then snapshots three client-address globals via ReadClientState(sub_4011B8,4): [0x468f24]->[0x4d22458], [0x4db37a8]->local, [0x4db3784]->[0x4d2245c] (cached client base pointers). Prints "HuntBot Loaded" via sub_4010DC (UI console log), then sets dword[0x4db381c]=1, dword[0x4db3824]=0, dword[0x4db3b5c]=2 (mode/state flags). No return value.

0x42cc70.name: huntBotUnload
0x42cc70.purpose: HuntBot shutdown routine. Calls sub_40133E (teardown), prints "Unloaded" via sub_4010DC (UI console), then clears the two master run flags dword[0x4db3838]=0 (bot enabled) and dword[0x4db381c]=0 (loaded flag set by huntBotInit). Counterpart to huntBotInit at 0x42cbd7.

0x42d317.name: recordSaveLoadDialog
0x42d317.purpose: Save/Load handler for the movement 'Record' (.sav/.savd) feature. Fills an OPENFILENAMEA struct (filter "Sav Files", default "record.sav", GetCurrentDirectoryA) and, if recording flag dword[0x4db3950]==1, prints "Record done. Saving Record." and calls GetSaveFileNameA to write the recorded waypoint arrays. On save it force-appends ".sav"/".savd" (strstr sub_44AF30, strcat sub_44A5A0), mirror-reverses the recorded step table at 0x4da3cf8 (entries stride 0x10, count dword[0x4db37e0]) writing terminator markers 7/0xa into +0x4da3d04, opens the file (fopen sub_44A9A0) and fwrites it (sub_44A876). On load it GetOpenFileNameA's, freads the record buffers 0x4da3cf8/0x4d8f118/0x4b17b9c (sub_44B1E6/sub_44B59F/sub_44B447), sets dword[0x4db3c40]=1, and Sleep(0x32)-paces. Uses string helpers sub_44A590 (strcpy) throughout.

0x42dab4.name: callRecordSubStep
0x42dab4.purpose: Trivial one-line thunk: sets up a stack frame and tail-calls sub_4014A6 with no arguments, then returns. A wrapper indirection around the record/step subsystem impl at sub_4014A6.

0x42dabe.name: recordStartRecording
0x42dabe.purpose: Starts movement recording. Prints "Recording" via sub_4010DC, sets recording flag dword[0x4db3950]=1, zeroes the two record buffers via memset (sub_44A750): 0x4da3cf8 for 0xfa00 bytes and 0x4b17b9c for 0x10000 bytes, then resets the step counter dword[0x4db37e0]=0, dword[0x4db37ec]=0 and playback index dword[0x4db3964]=0. Prepares the state that recordSaveLoadDialog (0x42d317) later serializes.

0x42db20.name: spawnNoobLoginThreads
0x42db20.purpose: Mass account-login worker spawner ('log noobs'). Guarded by dword[0x4db3d64] (runs once). WSAStartup(0x101); on failure prints "WSAStartup() returned error code %i" (sub_44A6FB sprintf + sub_40114F log) and returns 0xff. Opens "lognoobs.txt" (fopen sub_44A9A0), reads it line by line (sub_44B39C fgets into 0x578 buffer), splits each line on ';' (sub_44B2E0 strchr) into fixed 0x3c-byte fields of an account-record array at base 0x4d0744c (record stride 0xbb8) via strcpy sub_44A590, stores per-index into 0xdce148, then CreateThread(start=0x401523, param=&0xdce148[i]) for each parsed account with Sleep(0x32) between spawns. Finally prints "Logging on noobs, threads %i" with count dword[0x4db3dcc]. Returns 0.

0x42dd58.name: chatCommandDispatcher
0x42dd58.purpose: Large keyword chat-command dispatcher: takes a command string (arg [ebp+8], decremented by 1 into [ebp-0xc]) and prefix-matches it (strstr sub_44AF30) against a long table of hotword commands, toggling the corresponding feature global for each hit. Handles: "autosay" (copies text to 0x4af84dc, sets interval dword[0x4db39a0]=0x32), "PING" (seeds spoof bytes at 0x4d7d6d4.., dword[0x4db3de0]=1), "NEAR"/"SDNEAR" (target-mode dword[0x4db3ad0]=1/0), "MWALLBEHIND" (reads player X/Y/Z via ReadClientState from [0x4db3784]/[0x4db372c]/[0x4db3728]/[0x468f30], computes an adjacent-tile position with sub_40143D/sub_401037 and emits a wall/move frame via sub_4012CB opcode 0xc6c then Sleep 0xa), "PAUSEBOT" (dword[0x4db3948]=1), "AUTORING" (tick-throttled 0x190 via sub_44A7A8, toggles dword[0x4db3a08]=atoi(arg+9)), "AUTOSSA"/"SDCOMBO" (0x2bc throttle, dword[0x4db3a04]/[0x4db3a74]), "STOPMANA" (dword[0x4db3914]=1), "PUSHMAX"/"PUSHMAXD" (dword[0x4db3928]=1, direction dword[0x469108]=1/-1), "LOGOUT" (dword[0x4db39d0] logout-max toggle), "SSAFAST" (delay dword[0x4690a8]=atoi clamped >=0x19 else 0x1f4, dword[0x4db39f0]). Each branch logs its On/Off state via sub_4010DC and jumps to the common tail 0x4307b1. Sets dispatcher flags dword[0x4db38fc]=0, dword[0x4690d8]=0 on entry.

0x4307bf.name: setStepPosWest
0x4307bf.purpose: Computes a tile-position global one step to the west: reads player-position base dword[0x468f00], subtracts 4 (one map cell in the client's coordinate units), and stores the result into dword[0xdce044] (west-neighbor position cache used by the walk/push logic). No return value.

0x4307db.name: setStepPosEast
0x4307db.purpose: Computes a tile-position global one step to the east: reads player-position base dword[0x468f00], adds 4, and stores into dword[0xdce040] (east-neighbor position cache). Mirror of setStepPosWest (0x4307bf); the pair seed the neighbor tiles consumed by the push/move packet builders.

0x430886.name: patchClientAntiIdlePong
0x430886.purpose: Patches a client instruction/field to spoof a ping/pong or anti-idle response. ReadClientState(sub_4011B8) reads dword at [0x468efc] (checked against sentinel 0x1d5850f) and word at [0x4db37c8] (checked against 0x3475). When arg [ebp+8]==1 it writes 0x90-fill (NOP) 2-byte patches into the client via WriteProcessMemory helper sub_401285 at [0x468efc], +2, +4 and at [0x4db37c8] (disabling a client check). When arg==0 it restores the original bytes from local tables 0x466020/0x466024/0x466028. Returns 1.

0x430c02.name: injectWalkPathBytes
0x430c02.purpose: Streams a computed walk/auto-walk step sequence into the client, gated by master flag dword[0x4db3cc0]==1 (else returns 0). Accumulates a running counter dword[0x4db3e14] += arg[ebp+8]. Reads player X/Y/Z mirrors via ReadClientState (sub_4011B8) from [0x4db372c]/[0x4db3728]/[0x468f30]. Writes 0x90 marker bytes and per-step direction bytes (clamped to range 0..7 = the walk-direction opcode set) into the client at [0x468f00], the west-neighbor [0xdce044] and east-neighbor [0xdce040] position slots using WriteProcessMemory helper sub_401285, plus fixed bytes from constants 0x46602c/0x46601c. Returns 0.

0x430daf.name: bigIntSubtract256
0x430daf.purpose: Byte-wise big-integer subtraction of two little-endian multi-precision operands. Inputs: arg[ebp+8]=minuend ptr, arg[ebp+0xc]=subtrahend ptr, arg[ebp+0x10]=byte length, arg[ebp+0x18]=output ptr. memsets a 0x200-byte local result (sub_44A750), loops over each byte propagating a borrow ([ebp-0x208]): if digit underflows, result = 0xff+1 - sub - borrow + min and sets borrow. On final borrow (negative result) returns 0; otherwise memcpy's (sub_44A9C0) the result to the output and returns 1. RSA/crypto bignum primitive supporting the login/RSA path.

0x4310c2.name: bigIntMultiply256
0x4310c2.purpose: Byte-wise big-integer (schoolbook) multiplication of two little-endian multi-precision operands. Args: [ebp+8]=A ptr (advanced per outer iteration), [ebp+0xc]=B ptr, [ebp+0x10]=len(A), [ebp+0x14]=len(B), [ebp+0x18]=output. memsets a 0x200 accumulator (sub_44A750), nested loop multiplies each A[i]*B[j], accumulates with a carry ([ebp-0x208]) shifted >>8, masks &0xff per digit, then adds the final carry, and memcpy's (sub_44A9C0) len(A)+len(B) result bytes to the output. Returns 1. Companion to bigIntSubtract256 (0x430daf) in the RSA modpow used for the login handshake.

0x43124a.name: buildRsaLoginPacket
0x43124a.purpose: Assembles and sends the encrypted Tibia login/challenge packet for a spawned login worker (arg[ebp+8]=socket, [ebp+0xc]=16-byte key/nonce ptr, [ebp+0x10]=account-record index). Lays out a header (bytes 0x0a,0x02,0x00,0x20,0x03,0x00), memcpy's (sub_44A9C0) the 16-byte key, then reads per-account fields from the account-record array (base 0x4d07488/0x4d074c4/0x4d07500, stride 0xbb8) using atoi (sub_44AE5F), fread-int (sub_44A680) and strcpy (sub_44A590) to fill account name / password / character fields. Fetches the RSA modulus text via sub_401370 into a 0x2bc buffer, opens "rsa.txt" (fopen sub_44A9A0), sets exponent 0x10001, and calls sub_453D0B (RSA encrypt) over the assembled block. Finally send()s a 0x87-length header (0x85 payload) on the socket. Returns 1. This is the RSA client->server login frame builder for the mass-login threads.

0x4314ce.name: deriveMachineIdFromUuid
0x4314ce.purpose: Derives a machine/session identifier from the network MAC-based UUID. LoadLibraryA("RPCRT4"), GetProcAddress("UuidCreateSequential"), calls it into a 16-byte UUID (the trailing 6 bytes are the NIC MAC). Copies UUID bytes [2..7] into a local, takes the dword at offset +0x24-relative (the node/MAC dword at [ebp-0x24]), XORs it with 0x5331, and stores the result into global dword[0x4db39e0] (the derived hardware-ID / licensing fingerprint). Returns 0 if RPCRT4 fails to load.

0x420393.name: loadConfigLists
0x420393.purpose: Config/list loader. memsets and fills the bot's lookup tables from six .txt files opened via sub_44A9A0(fopen)/read with sub_44B39C(fgets)/sub_44B2E0(strchr ';')/sub_44AE5F(atoi). Loads either otitenids.txt or itenids.txt depending on sub_401177 result into the item-id maps at 0x4d78814 and 0x4d1d3f0 (with the temp buffer at 0x4ce4d98/0x4d38814); tradehelper.txt into the 0x4b03d9c-stride-0x32 name table plus id array 0x4b038ec; enemies.txt into the 0x4cc8c60 (stride 0x64) records and pointer array 0x4caa7fc, setting the enemy count at [0x469064]; customhotkeys.txt (EMPTY sentinel, ';' delimiter) into the 0x4d2a19c stride-0x32 table and pointer array 0x4d299cc, setting hotkey count [0x4db37fc]; friends.txt into 0x4cb05c0. Each file is closed with sub_44A820(fclose). Pure startup resource ingestion, no packet/RPM.

0x421735.name: resolveClientFieldHi77a3e4
0x421735.purpose: Address-resolver helper. Takes the client module base cached at [0x4db37d4], adds fixed RVA 0x77a3e4, and stores the resulting client.exe address into the local slot [0xdd6e7c] so later ReadClientState calls can read that field. One of the many post-attach 'resolve field address' one-liners.

0x421753.name: resolveClientFieldHi77a3c4
0x421753.purpose: Address-resolver helper. Adds RVA 0x77a3c4 to the client base [0x4db37d4] and stores the computed client.exe address into slot [0xdd6e78]. Sibling of resolveClientFieldHi77a3e4 (0x421735); both resolve adjacent client fields (0x77a3c4 vs 0x77a3e4, 0x20 apart) for later RPM reads.

0x42176e.name: attackScanAndFire
0x42176e.purpose: Attack driver over the creature array. Walks the client creature table from base [0x468f20] in stride [0x468f9c] up to base+0x1100, reading each entry's fields via sub_4011B8 (MB_ReadClientState thunk). For a candidate it re-reads id at +0x20, then rescans the mirrored creature list [0x468f38]..[0x4db37ac] (stride 0xE0, id at -4) to confirm the target is still present; if so it issues opcode 0xA1 (ATTACK) through sub_401217 (MB_SendAction 2-arg builder), then Sleep([0x468f90]+0xFA). Reads the status-message field ([0x468f44] via sub_401370) and string-compares (sub_44A4D0) against 'This action is not permitted in a protection zone.' and 'Target lost.' to set a status byte and clear the message (sub_4013BB). Aborts (returns 1) when GetAsyncKeyState(VK_ESCAPE 0x1b) is pressed.

0x4219ef.name: tagCreatureFieldById
0x4219ef.purpose: Creature-array field setter. Given a nonzero id arg [ebp+8], iterates the mirrored creature list from [0x468f38] in stride 0xE0 up to [0x4db37ac], reading each entry's id at offset -4 (sub_4011B8) and its liveness flag at +0 (sub_401041). For every live entry it writes the 4-byte arg into field +0x5c of that entry via sub_4011BD (MB_write helper), i.e. stamps a marker/target-id onto all live creatures. Returns 1.

0x421a6b.name: tagCreaturesExceptSelf
0x421a6b.purpose: Variant of tagCreatureFieldById (0x4219ef). Reads the self/local creature id at [0x4db3784] (sub_4011B8), then iterates the creature list [0x468f38]..[0x4db37ac] (stride 0xE0, id at -4); it skips the entry whose id equals self, and for every other live entry (liveness via sub_401041) writes the arg [ebp+8] into field +0x5c (sub_4011BD). Same 'stamp field +0x5c' mechanism as 0x4219ef but excludes the player's own creature.

0x421b08.name: updateCreatureStateFields
0x421b08.purpose: Creature-state field updater dispatched by a command id. Reads self id [0x4db3784], iterates the creature list [0x468f38]..[0x4db37ac] (stride 0xE0), matches the entry whose id equals target arg [ebp+8] (excluding self and ids > 0x40000000), checks its type/flag byte at -1 == 0x40, and its liveness (sub_401041). When cmd [ebp+0xc] == [0x469508] it writes a burst of fields onto that creature: +0x70=3, +0x6c=0x72, +0x64=0x72, +0x68=arg[ebp+0x10], +0x60=0x72, +0x5c=cmd via sub_4011BD; otherwise it stores cmd into +0x5c and, when cmd==0x82, scans the 0x64-entry table at 0x4d072bc for a matching id and writes +0x70=3/+0x6c=0x72/+0x64=0x5e/+0x68=arg/+0x60=0x72. Effectively a per-creature status/animation state machine keyed on creature id.

0x421d67.name: resolveKeyStateSlot0x1b
0x421d67.purpose: One-liner resolver. Computes 0x1b - [0x469514] and stores it into slot [0xdd5b0c]. [0x469514] is a config/offset value; result is a derived index/key stored for later use (function body is a 7-instruction stub; the large reported size spans following aligned code).

0x4241ad.name: openLuaScriptDialog
0x4241ad.purpose: Lua script file picker. Builds an OPENFILENAME (filter 'Lua Files', default 'newscript.lua', title 'Open a file', initial dir from GetCurrentDirectoryA, flag 0x80000=OFN_NOCHANGEDIR) via sub_44A590(strcpy) and calls GetOpenFileNameA. On selection it ShellExecuteA(NULL,NULL,<path>,...) to open the chosen .lua with its default editor; returns 1 on success, 0 if cancelled.

0x424294.name: writeClientFloatToggle
0x424294.purpose: Writes a hardcoded float into a client field based on a boolean arg. Resolves the target address as [0x468f04]+0x58 via sub_4011B8. Builds an 8-byte double: for arg==1 the double 0x406b2000_00000000 (=216.0625-ish, high dword 0x406b2000), for arg==0 the double 0x40400000_00000000 (=32.0-ish, high dword 0x40400000), assembled with sub_44A9C0(memcpy), then written to the client field with sub_401285 (MB_write helper, 8 bytes). A two-state numeric toggle pushed into client memory.

0x424312.name: mirrorClientField468fb0
0x424312.purpose: One-liner: copies the client-address/value at [0x468fb0] into local slot [0xdd56d4]. Snapshots a resolved client field pointer into the bot's working-copy global (5-instruction stub; reported size spans trailing aligned code).

0x4295bd.name: dialogInitSettingsAndVocation
0x4295bd.purpose: Config-dialog init/populate (WM_INITDIALOG path). Formats '%sSETTINGS.txt' into buffer 0xdd570c (sub_44A6FB sprintf) and opens it (sub_44A9A0 fopen). Reads two self stats via sub_4011B8 from [0x4db3794] and [0x4db37a8] and compares them (ratios, thresholds 0x2bc/0x4b0) to auto-classify the character vocation, copying 'noob'/'sorcerer'/'knight'/'paladin' into 0xdd5c10 and setting flag [0x4db3d28]. Then reads successive lines of SETTINGS.txt (sub_44B39C fgets, sub_44B3F3, sub_44A680 strlen) and pushes each value into dialog controls via SetDlgItemTextA/SetDlgItemInt (control ids 0x3e8-0x45f: names, timings, thresholds, the Creaturelist label 0x42a, help banner 0x3f1). Pure GUI state load from the settings file.

0x42a51e.name: dialogSaveSettingsToConfig
0x42a51e.purpose: Config-dialog save handler (counterpart of dialogInitSettingsAndVocation). Opens config.txt (sub_44A9A0 fopen) and writes it line by line: leading flag lines emit 1/0 based on globals [0x4db3d48], [0x4db39b8], [0x46959c] via sub_44B725 (fprintf-int, also used with 0xa to emit newlines); then for each dialog control it GetDlgItemTextA(hwnd, id, buf[0xc8], 0x32) and appends the string with sub_44B6E2 (fputs). Control ids read include 0x541, 0x5b9, 0x43b, 0x424, 0x441, 0x442, 0x445, 0x45f, 0x431 (character name, hotkey/timing/threshold settings). Persists the whole settings panel back to config.txt.

0x42b43b.name: stubReturnZero
0x42b43b.purpose: Trivial stub: standard prologue, xor eax,eax, returns 0. Placeholder/no-op (likely an unimplemented handler or default callback).

0x42b442.name: tcpConnect
0x42b442.purpose: Blocking TCP client connect. socket(AF_INET=2, SOCK_STREAM=1, 0) via sub_44A2AE; fills sockaddr_in with family 2, address from arg [ebp+8] and port from arg [ebp+0xc] (stored raw, caller supplies network order), then connect() (sub_44A2A2) to a 0x10-byte sockaddr. On socket==-1 or connect==-1 it calls WSAGetLastError (sub_44A2C0) and returns -1; otherwise returns the connected socket fd. Generic outbound TCP helper (used by the tibia.com/tibiadb.com HTTP scraping/licensing paths).

0x431706.name: logIfConsoleEnabled
0x431706.purpose: Guarded log wrapper: if global console-enable flag [0x4db38e0]==1, forwards its single char* argument to sub_4013F7 (the log/print sink); otherwise no-ops. Thin gate in front of the app's logging primitive.

0x431720.name: throttledConsoleWrite
0x431720.purpose: Rate-limited raw console writer. Reads the monotonic ms clock via sub_44A7A8; if more than 0x3e8(1000)ms elapsed since last-tick [0x4db3e28] it resets [0x4db3e28] and the per-window counter [0x4db3e24]=0. Increments [0x4db3e24]; while <=0xf0(240) and provided mode flags ([0x4db38dc]/[0x4db38e0]) permit, walks the argument string char-by-char calling WriteConsoleA on handle [0x4d22460] one byte at a time. Implements a 240-writes-per-second console throttle.

0x4317bc.name: licenseAuthorizeCheck
0x4317bc.purpose: tibiadb.com license/authorization check over raw WinSock. WSAStartup(2.2), builds host 'tibiadb.com' from string bases at 0x46de48+, gethostbyname, socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,IPPROTO_TCP), htons(port 0x50/80), connect, sets non-blocking via ioctlsocket(FIONBIO). Formats an HTTP request into a 0x22b buffer with sub_44A6FB (sprintf) embedding '/authorize.php?id=' plus id fields from [0x4db3c94]/[0x4db3d98], send()s it, then recv-loops with 10ms Sleep and a ~7500ms(0x1d4c) timeout scanning for 'locked'/'unlocked'/'ckv5' tokens via sub_44AF30(strstr) and sub_44AE5F(atoi). On 'unlocked' stores parsed expiry/flags into [0x4db3cf8], [0x4db3c90]; sets fatal flag [0x4db3d90] on oversized reply and success flag [0x4db3d9c]=1. Also adjusts license byte-checksum base [0x468f24] by 0x43c-sum. Returns status code (0/7/9/0xa/0xb).

0x431ce6.name: httpGetCharacterPage
0x431ce6.purpose: Generic HTTP GET fetcher for a character/community web page. Strips a leading 'http:' and '//' from arg[+0xc] via sub_44AF30(strstr), resolves host arg[+8] with gethostbyname, opens a TCP socket to port 80, connect, non-blocking ioctlsocket, formats the request with sub_44A6FB(sprintf) using template '/community/?subtopic=characters&name=' + host + path, send()s, then recv-loops (0x46ms Sleep, up to 0x1000 bytes) accumulating the response into caller buffer arg[+0x10], advancing the running length. Used to scrape a character profile page.

0x431f70.name: urlEncodeSpacesToPlus
0x431f70.purpose: In-place minimal URL encoder: walks the NUL-terminated string in arg[+8], replacing every 0x20 (space) byte with 0x2b ('+') and advancing. Returns the original string pointer. Prepares a query value for the HTTP GET helpers above.

0x432d36.name: advanceAllTimerCounters
0x432d36.purpose: Global tick/offset advance: adds the single int argument (a delta) to a large fixed list of ~70 accumulator globals in two bands — the 0x468exx/0x468fxx license+base band (0x468ee4..0x468f44) and the 0x4db37xx timing/state band (0x4db3708..0x4db37cc), plus 0xdce040/0xdce044. Effectively a bulk 'age all these counters/pointers by delta' routine; returns 0.

0x433161.name: countLeadingCharRun
0x433161.purpose: Counts how many consecutive leading bytes of string arg[+8] equal the char in arg[+0xc] (low byte), capped at 0x20(32) iterations, stopping at NUL. Returns the run length. Small string-scan helper.

0x4331bc.name: walkStepToTargetThrottled
0x4331bc.purpose: Throttled single-step walk toward a target tile. Rate-gates on [0x4db3e3c] with a 0xc8(200)ms minimum interval (returns 1 if too soon). Sets walk-speed/state [0x469114]=0x32, clears path scratch [0x4db3b40]/[0x4db3b3c], zeroes the two 0x640-byte path buffers at 0x4aeb7e4 and 0x4aeb1a4 via sub_44A750(memset), then calls the A*/path solver sub_401410 with (fromX,fromY,fromX,fromY,toX,toY from args +8/+0xc/+0x10/+0x14). On success and path length [0x4db3b3c]>2, reads next-node coords from 0x4aeb7e8/0x4aeb1a8 and issues the actual step via sub_4010EB(x,y,nx,ny); records last-step time in [0x4db3e3c]. Returns 1/0.

0x433294.name: checkDirectionBlocked
0x433294.purpose: Checks whether direct movement between two points (from arg+8/+0xc to arg+0x10/+0x14) is blocked by a disabled direction hotkey. Sets [0x4db39a8]=1, then for each axis delta tests the corresponding hotkey/toggle id via sub_401235: dx>0 -> id 0x27(right), dx<0 -> 0x25(left), dy>0 -> 0x28(down), dy<0 -> 0x26(up). If the relevant toggle is set it returns blocked(1); otherwise clears [0x4db39a8]=0 and returns allowed. Direction-permission gate for the walker.

0x4333e1.name: runWaypointNavigator
0x4333e1.purpose: Core waypoint/pathing state machine. Reads self position via sub_4011B8 from the RPM self-coord mirrors [0x4db372c]=X, [0x4db3728]=Y, [0x468f30]=Z. Drives phase var [0x4db38e4] (0=idle,1=select-target,2=walking). In phase 1 it scans the 0x10-byte waypoint records at base 0x61d5e8 (fields +0=x,+4=y,+8=z,+0xc=type), picks the nearest reachable one using Chebyshev distance sub_44ACF5 and reachability solver sub_401410, saving the chosen index in [0x4db3e38] and stall-timer in [0x4db3e50]. In phase 2 it loads the selected waypoint's x/y/z (into locals) and, when within range, either emits a 'GOUP'/floor-change command (via sub_44A590+sub_401140 with string 0x46e208) for type 0x32, or takes discrete 7-tile steps checking tile walkability with sub_40108C and moving with sub_4010EB/sub_40108C, advancing to the next waypoint on arrival. Uses [0x4db3e40] as an in-progress flag and [0x469114] walk-speed. This is the auto-walker/cavebot executor.

0x433a19.name: appendWaypointRecord
0x433a19.purpose: Appends a waypoint into the 0x90-byte-stride waypoint table at base 0x4743a0, indexed by count [0x4db3e7c]. Stores arg+8 -> +0x4(x), arg+0xc -> +0x8(y), arg+0x10 -> +0xc(z), sets +0x0=1(active), and copies the label/action string arg+0x14 into +0x10 via sub_44A590(strcpy). Increments the waypoint count [0x4db3e7c] and returns 1. Waypoint-list builder used when loading a route.

0x433af7.name: findScriptSlotByName
0x433af7.purpose: Linear search over the loaded-script table (stride 0xb9c, base 0x5e3520, count [0x4db3e60]) comparing each record's name against arg+8 via sub_44A4D0(strcmp/strcmpi). Returns the matching slot index, or -1 if not found. Lookup helper for the script/tab registry.

0x4341f7.name: resetScriptAndWaypointState
0x4341f7.purpose: Full reset of the navigator/script subsystem. memsets the 0x3e80-byte waypoint array at 0x61d5e8 via sub_44A750, zeroes navigator state ([0x4db3e44],[0x4db3e38],[0x4db3e60],[0x4db3e6c],[0x4db3e70],[0x4db38e4]) and, when reload flag [0x4db3d7c] set, clears further script flags ([0x4db38bc],[0x4db3838],[0x4db3e7c],[0x4db3e78]) and tears down the Lua VM: if [0x4db3e5c]==1 and lua_State [0x61d5e0]!=0, calls lua_close([0x61d5e0]) and clears [0x4db3e5c], then re-inits via sub_40103C. Returns 1.

0x4342bb.name: shutdownScriptEngine
0x4342bb.purpose: Tear-down of the script engine without re-init. Zeroes navigator phase [0x4db38e4], script count [0x4db3e60] and waypoint count [0x4db3e7c]; if lua_State [0x61d5e0]!=0 and initialized-flag [0x4db3e5c]==1, calls lua_close([0x61d5e0]) and clears [0x4db3e5c]. Returns 1. Lighter counterpart to resetScriptAndWaypointState.

0x43430d.name: loadScriptFileIntoSlot
0x43430d.purpose: Loads a script file (path in arg+0xc) into a free slot of the 0xb9c-stride script table at 0x5e3520. Installs an SEH frame (0x4641d0). Trims the path at markers via sub_44B2E0(strchr for 0x20/0x0d/0x0a). Scans up to 0x50 slots, finds a matching/free one, marks +0x5e40b8 record active=1, stamps id [0x4db3e68] into +0x5e3628, memsets a 0x78 sub-block from template 0x472e9c via sub_44A9C0. Then invokes the Lua 'scriptloader' function: lua_getfield(L=[0x61d5e0],'scriptloader'), lua_gettop, lua_pushstring(path), lua_pushnumber(slotIndex), lua_pcall(2,1,0). On error retrieves lua_tolstring, copies it to error buffer 0x5e3420 (sub_44A590) and logs via sub_4013F7; on success sets loaded-flag [0x4db3e78]=1. Restores stack with lua_settop. Bridges file->Lua script registration.

0x40db39.name: cavebotFollowAttackTick
0x40db39.purpose: Cavebot/follow-and-attack tick. Clears reached-flag [0x4db39a8], reads the follow-target id from client [0x4db3784] and the attack-target id from [0x468f34] via ReadClientState (sub_4011B8). When mode [0x4db3ab8]==1 it re-reads target [0x468f34], latches it into [0x4db38ac]/[0x4db3abc]/[0x4db3aa8], writes it back to the client with sub_401285, and issues opcode 0xA1 (ATTACK) through sub_401217 (the 2-arg SendAction builder 0x405f1d). It then runs a step/pathing loop: reads self y [0x4db372c] and self z [0x4db3728], accumulates walk deltas into [0x4db3ac4]/[0x4db3ac8], and probes walk directions by calling sub_401235 with dir codes 0x25/0x26/0x27/0x28 (blocked-direction test); scans the creature array (base [0x468f38], stride 0xE0, bound [0x4db37ac]) using record visibility (sub_401041) and names (sub_401370, strcmp sub_44A4D0) to detect the "There is no way." server message, on which it aborts the step (sets [0x4db39a8]=1, resets [0x4db3abc]/[0x4db3890]) and updates cavebot position state [0x4afd33c]/[0x4afd338]/[0x4afd340]. Uses sub_40143D to convert relative tile coords to a mirror map record and sub_44ACF5 (abs) for distance checks; paces with Sleep(0xA).

0x40ee03.name: cavebotResetWaypointAnchor
0x40ee03.purpose: Tiny setter: copies the resolved client address/global [0x468f20] into cavebot state slot [0x4afd330]. Re-anchors the cavebot's current-waypoint/last-known reference before a walk cycle. No args, no client I/O.

0x40ee12.name: debugScanCreatureMapSquare
0x40ee12.purpose: Debug map-square scanner for a flagged creature. Reads self anchors (self y [0x4db372c], self z [0x4db3728], name/tile base [0x468f30]) via ReadClientState, then loops the creature array (base [0x468f38], stride 0xE0, bound [0x4db37ac]); for a record whose flag byte [record-1]==0x40, whose slot [record+0x20]==the name base, and whose visibility sub_401041==1, it converts the record's (x,y) to a mirror tile via sub_40143D, reads the tile field at +0xa4, formats "mpsq %x" with sprintf (sub_44A6FB) into buffer 0x4ce9430 and prints it via sub_40114F. Then double-loops 0x12 x 0xE tiles around self, reading each tile's +0xa4 and re-emitting the "mpsq %x" debug line when != -1. Diagnostic dump of map-square item values; returns bool.

0x40f018.name: recolorTargetCreatures
0x40f018.purpose: Battle-list target highlighter/writer, throttled to ~300 ms (clock() sub_44A7A8 vs [0x4db3af8], gap 0x12c). Loops the creature array (base [0x468f38], stride 0xE0, bound [0x4db37ac]) skipping records with flag [record-1]==0x40, off-name ([record+0x20]!=[0x468f30]), hp<1 ([record+0x88]), or invisible (sub_401041). For each visible creature it fetches the name (sub_401370) and matches it against the target-name table at 0x4cc8c60 (100-byte stride, count [0x469064]) and, if enabled ([0x4db3af4]), a second id list at 0x4d072bc / table 0x4cb05c0 (count [0x4db38d8]). On a match it WRITES (sub_4011BD = WriteProcessMemory helper) recolor/priority bytes into the client creature record: a color code (0x5e/0x4f/0x4d, selected by class array [i*4+0x4caa7fc]) into fields +0x60/+0x64/+0x68/+0x6c, plus mode-specific marker values (0x84/0xfb/0x80 into +0x5c and 3 into +0x70) — i.e. it paints matched targets in the client's own creature struct.

0x40f3f5.name: strToLowerAscii
0x40f3f5.purpose: In-place ASCII lowercaser. Walks the NUL-terminated string at [ebp+8], and for each byte in ('@','[') i.e. 'A'..'Z' (excluding 0x20) adds 0x20 to convert to lowercase, writing back in place; returns the original pointer. Pure CRT-style string helper, no client I/O.

0x40f43f.name: creatureIdIsOffscreen
0x40f43f.purpose: Predicate: given a creature id (arg [ebp+8]), scans the creature array (base [0x468f38], stride 0xE0, bound [0x4db37ac]) via ReadClientState for the record whose id field [record-4] matches, then returns (sub_401041(record)==0), i.e. true when the matched creature is NOT on-screen/visible. Returns 1 if the id is not found at all (loop falls through to the mov eax,1 tail).

0x40f4ad.name: readCreatureFieldA0
0x40f4ad.purpose: One-line accessor: ReadClientState(creatureRecord + 0xA0, 4) — reads the 4-byte field at offset +0xA0 of the client creature record pointed to by arg [ebp+8] and returns it. A single named-offset getter used by the targeting code.

0x40f4ce.name: scanTilesForFieldsAndWalls
0x40f4ce.purpose: Field/magic-wall aware tile scanner for the targeting engine, gated by [0x4db3928] and throttled ~650 ms (clock() sub_44A7A8 vs [0x4db3b10], gap 0x28a). Reads self anchors (self y [0x4db372c], self z [0x4db3728], name base [0x468f30], follow id [0x4db3784], target id [0x468f34], and a mode field [0x468ef4]/[0x4db3724]) via ReadClientState. Iterates candidate targets (index -2..[0x469064], where -2/-1 map to the follow/target ids and >=0 index the name table 0x4cc8c60) and, for each on-name visible creature (via sub_401041, name sub_401370, strcmp sub_44A4D0), walks the tile grid around it with sub_40143D, reading each tile stack item id (+8) and testing it against wall/field id ranges (0x845..0x850) and id-list arrays 0x4d30344/[0x4db37f8], 0x4d339f4/[0x469068], 0x4d2249c/[0x46906c], plus the 0x79d marker and multipliers [0x469108]. Detects whether a straight/adjacent path to the target is blocked by magic walls / fields before the engine commits to an attack or rune cast.

0x40fbd9.name: attackComboEngineTick
0x40fbd9.purpose: Main attack/combo/targeting engine tick, a state machine dispatched on the mode selector [0x4db39a0] (values ~0x13/0x31-0x3b/0x65 etc.), gated by [0x4db39c8]/[0x4db39a0]/[0x4db390c] and a precondition sub_40145B. Reads self pos (y [0x4db372c], z [0x4db3728], name base [0x468f30]), follow id [0x4db3784], target id [0x468f34] via ReadClientState. Per-state, throttled by clock() (sub_44A7A8) against interval [0x469058] / stamps [0x4db3b18]/[0x4db3a18]: state 0x32 fires a single cast via sub_401398(0x4af84dc); state 0x33 loops the creature array (base [0x468f38] stride 0xE0 bound [0x4db37ac]) to find the target record, LOS/range-checks it with sub_4013F2 and sub_4014D8, converts its tile with sub_40143D, reads the tile stack field +0x34 and issues an aimed rune/attack via sub_4012CB (else stop-attack sub_401339) using rune-id [0x4db3aec]; state 0x34 matches each creature's name (sub_401370, strcpy sub_44A590, tolower sub_40100F) against a per-monster spell table at 0x4c8a2a8 (128-byte stride, count [0x4db38d4]) and casts the paired spell string from 0x4c6a2a8 via sub_401398, falling back to the literal "exori frigo" cast. All sends are chat/hotkey-string casts (sub_401398) or packet actions, each followed by Sleep(0xA/0x32). This is the healer/combo caster + targeting driver referenced in the overview.

0x41ce49.name: castRuneOnCreaturesInContainer
0x41ce49.purpose: Rune/item-on-creature attack loop. Snapshots several client bases via ReadClientState (sub_4011B8, 4-byte reads): self coords [0x4db372c]/[0x4db3728], and containers/creatures pointers [0x468f30],[0x468ef4],[0x4db3724],[0x4db371c],[0x4db3720]. Walks the container/creature table starting at [0x468f2c], striding +0x1EC per slot up to [0x4db377c]; for each active slot (flag at +0x34 !=0) it reads slot id at +0x30 and iterates its sub-entries with stride [0x468f6c] from base +0x2C to base + count([-0x44])*[0x468f6c]. For each sub-entry reads a type/opcode at +4: if it is a valid creature-band id (0 <= id < 0x65, i.e. a walkable-tile/creature index, and not the tile's own header at +4) it reads the target field at +8 and calls the 6-arg action builder sub_40105A(0, id1, id2, x, opcode=0x13, target) to emit a rune/use-on-target packet, then Sleep([0x468f90]) throttle. Aborts if ESC (GetAsyncKeyState 0x1B) is pressed. Uses sub_44A7A8 timestamps to bound the per-slot scan (<=0x44C ms) and total run; between passes if slot-id at +0x30 changed it re-reads. sub_4011C7(0) resets a state flag before the fallback Sleep([0x468f90]+0x190).

0x41d0e5.name: castHotkeyOnMatchingCreatures
0x41d0e5.purpose: Scans the creature/container table (base [0x468f2c], stride +0x1EC, bound [0x4db377c]) for slots whose active flag (+0x34) is set, then walks each slot's inner list of up to N entries (count at +0x30) at base +[0x468f5c]+0x3B with 12-byte (0xC) stride +1. Reads each entry's id and compares it against a target id [0x468fb0]; on match it emits an action via sub_4012DA(index, self-arg [0x4db3718], self-arg [0x4db371c], self-arg [0x4db3720], matchId, matchIndex, 1) — a per-target packet builder taking three live self scalars read through ReadClientState (sub_4011B8). Sleeps 8ms between emissions; aborts the whole scan when ESC (GetAsyncKeyState 0x1B) is held (returns 0). Returns 0 on completion.

0x41d519.name: walkAndCastAlongCreaturePath
0x41d519.purpose: Movement + attack driver over the creature/tile table. Snapshots self coords via ReadClientState (sub_4011B8): [0x4db372c]->x, [0x4db3728]->y, [0x468f30]->z. Iterates slots from [0x468f2c] (stride +0x1EC, bound [0x4db377c]); param [ebp+0xC] is a mode selector (==0xA is a special 'index-match' mode). For each active slot (flag +0x34) walks inner entries (count at +0x30) at [0x468f5c]+0x3B, stride 0xC. Each entry id (at +1 within the 12-byte record) is filtered against a large blocklist of tile/ground ids (0x1CAE, [0x469038], [0x468fd4], [0x468fd8], 0xB37, 0xDB0, 0xB26, 0xB31, 0, and the 0xB30..0xB40 band) — these are skippable walkable tiles. Surviving ids are deduplicated through a 20-slot recent-id ring buffer at [0x4d7d684] (ids) / [0x4d7d634] (hit-counts, cap 0x14); the least-seen slot is evicted. On a match it builds a directed step/attack packet: mode 0xA path calls sub_4012DA(arg8, self.x+delta, ...) with a quadrant offset derived from (slot&3) and (slot>>2); otherwise calls sub_40123F(arg8, mode+0x40, id, slotIdx, entry) — a coordinate/target action. Logs the picked id (hi/lo bytes) via sprintf sub_44A6FB into buffer 0x4ce9430 then sub_40114F (log/print). Non-match branch (id!=0) calls walk helper sub_40112C(arg8, id, slotIdx), Sleeps [0x468f90]+0x1F4, then sub_40126C(arg8, mode) to confirm arrival — returns 0 if it fails. ESC (GetAsyncKeyState 0x1B) aborts, calling sub_4011C7(arg8) and Sleep([0x468f90]+0x64); returns 1 on that path.

0x41d9e6.name: verifySelfTileAndComputeAheadOffset
0x41d9e6.purpose: Self-localization / map-anchor routine that verifies the player's own tile in the client tile grid and computes a target tile some distance ahead. Guards re-entrancy with lock [0x4db3cc4] and a spin (Sleep 5) keyed off (([0x4db3c90]*[0x4db3c94]) mod 0x12 == 0x11). Caches the last verified self position in [0xdd9a10]=z,[0xdd9a14]=y,[0xdd9a18]=x plus tile pointer [0xdd9a0c] and grid indices [0x4d22444]/[0x4d22448]. Reads current self via ReadClientState (sub_4011B8): [0x468f24], [0x4db3784], [0x4db372c]->x, [0x4db3728]->y, [0x468f30]->z. If self pos unchanged, returns the cached tile-linear index computed from ([ebp+8],[ebp+0xC]) offsets modulo the 0x12x0xE (18x14) grid scaled by row stride [0x468f68]. If moved but within 5 tiles (abs deltas via sub_44ACF5), re-derives the tile pointer and grid origin, then scans that tile's creature list (stride [0x468f6c] from +0x2C) looking for the self-creature marker: entry type==0x63 whose id (+4) equals self id [0x4db3784], logging "verified self%x %x" via sprintf sub_44A6FB/sub_40114F. On verification updates the cached anchors and, throttled by sub_44A7A8 vs [0x4db3cc8] (200ms) and gated by [0x4db3874]==1, scans the AHEAD tile ("ntiles ahead: ") reacting to special ground/object ids by calling sub_401447 with light/effect codes (0x19F/0x1A6->0x3C, 0x198->0x4E, 0x199->0, 0x3D6->1, id%0x64==0x2D->0x2B, ...). Debug strings ":%x %x " dump the tile entries.

0x41e6f7.name: returnFalseStub
0x41e6f7.purpose: 7-byte stub that sets AL=0 and returns (standard MSVC prologue push ebp/mov ebp,esp; xor al,al; pop ebp; ret). A predicate that always returns false — likely a disabled/placeholder hook or a default 'no' handler in a function-pointer table adjacent to the surrounding scan routines.

0x41e6fe.name: targetNearestCreatureAndAttack
0x41e6fe.purpose: Nearest-target selection + auto-attack driver over the creature array (base [0x468f38], stride +0xE0, bound [0x4db37ac]). For each live creature (flag at -4 !=0, visible at +0x88 !=0) it reads: hp/id fields (sub_401041 at slot -> flag [ebp-0x28]), a per-creature blob at +0x5C (when [0x4db3cd8]==1 and blob==0 it back-writes 0x119 via sub_4011BD), a z/floor at +0x20 compared to self z [0x468f30], and a category at -1. Gated by main-attack-enabled [0x4db38b8]==1 and a monster-type check (-0x3C==0x40). Reads creature x[+0x28]/y[+0x24], computes Chebyshev distance to self ([0x4db372c]/[0x4db3728]) via abs (sub_44ACF5) and keeps the minimum within range [0x469054]+1, using sub_401370->sub_40121C to fetch a priority/threat weight (must be <= running best [ebp-8]). After the scan, throttled by sub_44A7A8 vs [0x4db3ce8] (100ms) and re-gated by [0x4db38b8]==1 && [0x4db3838]==0, it locks onto the chosen creature id [ebp-0x30]: builds its screen tile via sub_40143D+sub_4011B8, and if [0x469098]==1 (SAFEMODE/inject gate) calls sub_4014A1(id) (attack pre-step), else emits the ATTACK packet sub_401217(id, 0xA1) and back-writes the target id to client field [0x468f34] via sub_4011BD. Records target in [0x4db3ce4] and timestamps [0x4db3ce8]. Sleep 5. Uses [0x4db3cdc]/[0x4db3ce0] cooldowns and a PRNG-style refresh of client base [0x468f38] (magic 0x11875) when idle past 0x1B58 ms.

0x41ebd0.name: parseChatCommandAndSpells
0x41ebd0.purpose: Chat/console command dispatcher for remote-control ('.'-commands) and spell auto-reactions. Throttled (sub_44A7A8 vs [0x4db3cec], 500ms min). Reads the client chat line buffer [0x4db3778]: strlen (sub_44A680) must be >=2; a leading byte at [0x764434] must equal 0xAA (then cleared via sub_4011BD) — a 'new message' latch. Extracts sender name and message text: finds the ' 8'/separator token, copies sender into 0xdd6e80 region via sub_44A590, message body into buffer at [ebp-4]. Verifies the sender against a whitelist table at 0x4ce4d98 (stride 0x96 entries, strstr sub_44AF30); non-whitelisted senders are (when [0x4694fc]==1 and [0x4db3884]==1) echoed "*%s* %s %s" through sub_44A6FB+sub_401320 (channel/private say builder) and dropped. For whitelisted messages it strstr-matches spell strings ("exevo gran mas vis/tera/frigo/flam", "exori gran", "exevo mas san", "utamo vita", "utani gran hur") and, gated by cooldowns [0x4db3cec]/[0x4db3ccc], re-casts via say builder sub_401398. It also parses dot-commands: '.say' (speak text via sub_401320 if starts with '*', else sub_401398), '.move' (sets [0x4db388c]=1 follow-flag and atoi (sub_44AE5F) the x/y into [0x4db3ac4]/[0x4db3ac8]), '.stopfire' (clears fire globals [0x4db39a0],[0x4db3a5c],[0x4db3ae4],[0x4db3ae0],[0x4db3cd0] and announces "*%s* stopping fire"), '.stopfollow' (clears [0x4db388c], "*%s* stopping follow"), '.channel' (atoi channel id into [0x46905c], calls sub_401005, resets [0x4db39a0]/[0x4db3a5c]), and '.mana' (calls sub_4011F9 to request/announce mana). All say/announce paths funnel through sub_401320 (channel say) or sub_401398 (open say) with the bot name from 0x4d22278. Returns AL=0/1 handled flag.

0x4114ee.name: countWeightedMonstersNearPoint
0x4114ee.purpose: Walks the client creature array (base [0x468f38], stride 0xE0, terminator [0x4db37ac]) via ReadClientState(sub_4011B8). Per node it skips the self-creature (id at off -4 == [0x4db3784]), requires visible/alive (off +0x88 >= 1) and a type/category match at off +0x20 against param [ebp+0x10], and requires the per-creature predicate sub_401041 to return true, and byte flag at off -1 == 0x40 (a specific creature class). It then measures Chebyshev-style proximity of the creature's x (off +0x28) and y (off +0x24) to the passed target point (x=[ebp+8], y=[ebp+0xc]) using sub_44ACF5 (abs): within range 3 on both axes adds +1, within range (len-1)=2 adds +2, accumulating a weighted danger count in [ebp-4]. Finally clamps: if count>10, returns (count-10)/3+10. This is a monster-density / danger-score around a given tile.

0x411697.name: sumMonsterDistanceNearPoint
0x411697.purpose: Same creature-array scan (base [0x468f38], stride 0xE0, end [0x4db37ac], self-skip via off -4 == [0x4db3784], visible off +0x88 >= 1, byte off -1 == 0x40, predicate sub_401041, type off +0x20 == param [ebp+0x10]) as countWeightedMonstersNearPoint, but the acceptance gate requires abs(dx) (off +0x28 vs [ebp+8]) <= 9 AND abs(dy) (off +0x24 vs [ebp+0xc]) <= 9 (screen box). For each accepted creature it computes manhattan distance abs(dx)+abs(dy) and keeps the running minimum in [ebp-4] (seeded 0x24). Returns that minimum (capped at 0x24 sentinel when none) — i.e. distance to the closest matching monster to the given point, or 0x24 if none in range.

0x411833.name: isMonsterOnScreenSelf
0x411833.purpose: Creature-array scan (base [0x468f38], stride 0xE0, end [0x4db37ac]) skipping self (off -4 == [0x4db3784]). Acceptance: abs(creature.x off +0x28 - self.x ReadClientState([0x4db372c])) <= 7 AND abs(creature.y off +0x24 - self.y [0x4db3728]) <= 6 (the Tibia visible viewport half-extents), visible off +0x88 >= 1, floor/category off +0x20 == self floor ReadClientState([0x468f30]), predicate sub_401041 true, and byte flag off -1 == 0x40. Returns 1 as soon as one such creature exists, else 0 — a boolean 'is there a monster in the player's screen box on the same floor'.

0x4119a9.name: isMonsterWithinRangeSelf
0x4119a9.purpose: Identical structure to isMonsterOnScreenSelf but the box half-extent is the caller-supplied radius param [ebp+8] for both axes instead of the fixed 7/6: accepts a creature when abs(creature.x off +0x28 - self.x [0x4db372c]) <= [ebp+8] AND abs(creature.y off +0x24 - self.y [0x4db3728]) <= [ebp+8], same floor (off +0x20 == [0x468f30]), visible (off +0x88 >= 1), predicate sub_401041, byte off -1 == 0x40, self-skip via off -4 == [0x4db3784]. Returns 1 if any matching monster is within N sqm, else 0.

0x411c0d.name: lookupCreatureNameSetting
0x411c0d.purpose: Name-to-config lookup. Copies the caller's creature-name string (arg [ebp+8]) into a local 0x100 buffer via sub_44A590 (strncpy-like) and uppercases it with sub_40100F. Then linearly scans a name table at 0x4c8a2a8 (stride 0x80/128 bytes per entry, entry count [0x4db38d4]) comparing each entry with sub_44A4D0 (case-insensitive strcmp); on a match it returns the parallel per-name int value from the array at 0x4af4614 (indexed [i]). Returns default 4 when no name matches. Resolves a monster/player name to its configured setting (e.g. priority/danger class).

0x411cae.name: runTargetSelectionEngine
0x411cae.purpose: Large targeting/battle-list engine (sets busy flag [0x4db39b0]=1 on entry). Reads self x/y/z (ReadClientState [0x4db372c],[0x4db3728],[0x468f30]) and follow id [0x4db3784], then walks the creature array (base [0x468f38], stride 0xE0, end [0x4db37ac]) with a per-node 'changed' dirty check against the mirror at 0x4aec914[idx] (idx = (node-base)/0xE0). For each creature it skips self ([node-4]==[0x4db3784]) and an optional exclude id ([ebp+0xc]), applies predicate sub_401041, an id-in-list check against a 5-entry recent table 0x4d1d3dc and a 0xC8-entry table 0x4aec5f4 (tracked via ctr [0x4db3ba0]), resolves the creature name via sub_401370 and feeds it through lookupCreatureNameSetting-style tables (name table 0x4c8a2a8 stride 0x80, values 0x4af4614), checks the name against a per-monster config list at 0x4ce4d98 (stride 0x96) with sub_44A4D0. On a selected target it formats human-readable distance strings ('*%s*%s %i west and %i south and %i below..' / '..on the same level!..') from dx=x-[ebp-0x504], dy=y-[ebp-0x4f8] into buffers 0x4ce9430/0x4d22278 via sub_44A6FB, throttling announcements with sub_44A7A8 timestamps ([0x4db3b8c],[0x4db3b90]) and cooldown [0x469124], and compares the name against configured strings ('...' at 0x469c5c/0x469c60) with sub_44AF30. Clears [0x4db39b0] and returns the chosen target as a bool/al on the picked path. This is the monster/enemy target picker + battle announcer.

0x414857.name: hasTileFlagBit3
0x414857.purpose: Tiny predicate: indexes an int table at 0x4d38814 by param id [ebp+8] (dword ptr [id*4 + 0x4d38814]), masks bit 3 (& 8) and returns 1 if that bit is set, else 0. This is a per-item/per-tile-id property test against the 0x4d38814 attribute table (e.g. 'is walkable / is this a blocking or special tile type').

0x414877.name: runWalkNavigationEngine
0x414877.purpose: Large movement/cavebot navigation loop. Gates on run-state flags [0x4db3838],[0x4db3bbc],[0x4db3bc0]; Sleep(0x28) then scans the open-container/tile array (base [0x468f2c], stride 0x1ec, end [0x4db377c]) marking up to 0x14 slots in 0x4aea02c. Reads self x/y/z (ReadClientState [0x4db372c],[0x4db3728],[0x468f30]) and follow id [0x4db3784]. Then walks the creature array (base [0x468f38], stride 0xE0, end [0x4db37ac]): skips self (off -4 == follow id), reads visible/count off +0x88, checks a per-creature avoid/skip membership against tables 0x4aec464 (0x64 entries) and 0x4ae9d0c (0xC8 entries), resolves names via sub_401370 and matches configured lists at 0x4ce4d98 (stride 0x96) / 0x4aea25c (stride 0x32, 0x14 rows) with sub_44A4D0, incrementing hit counters 0x4aea20c and setting waypoint-arrival flags [0x469270],[0x4db3bb4]. Computes a directional step from max(abs(dx),abs(dy)) using sub_44ACF5 (abs) with dx=creature.x off +0x28 - self.x, dy off +0x24 - self.y, driving the walk toward/away and populating step state ([ebp-0x50],[ebp-0x74],[ebp-0x4c],[ebp-0x88],[ebp-0x20],[ebp-0x24]). This is the pathing/avoidance engine that picks the next walk direction.

0x4166ab.name: scanTilesForItemIdsThrottled
0x4166ab.purpose: 500ms-throttled tile-item scanner (guards on sub_44A7A8 elapsed since [0x4db3bd0] >= 0x1F4). Reads self x/y/z (ReadClientState [0x4db372c],[0x4db3728],[0x468f30]). Loops a 2x2 tile offset grid ([ebp-4],[ebp-0x14] in 0..1) resolving each tile's item-array base via sub_40143D(offX,offY), reading the tile stack count and iterating items using stride [0x468f6c] starting at +0x2c, reading each item's id at off +8. Matches the id against a fixed whitelist (0x1074,0xfab,0xfcf,0xfd4,0xfd9,0xfb9,0x10be,0xfde,0x1010,0x10e1,0x10e4,0x10e7 — a set of specific item type ids, likely food/consumables) and on a hit calls sub_4012CB(target=[0x469274], absX=self.x+offX, absY=self.y+offY, z=0, id, stackIndex) then Sleep(0x64). Fires an item-use action (eat food / use ground item) on nearby matching tile items.

0x41687f.name: recordPositionHistoryOnMove
0x41687f.purpose: Position-change recorder / movement tracker. Reads self x/y/z (ReadClientState [0x4db372c],[0x4db3728],[0x468f30]) plus three extra fields [0x4db3718],[0x4db371c],[0x4db3720]. If (x,y,z) equals the last-recorded position ([0x4db3800],[0x4db3804],[0x4db3808]) it returns 0 (no move). On a real move it appends the new x/y/z into a 16-byte-stride ring buffer at 0x4da3cf8/0x4da3cfc/0x4da3d00 indexed by counter [0x4db37e0], sets a boundary marker at 0x4da3d04 (index modulo 0xFA0=4000), increments [0x4db37e0], formats a log line (fmt 0x469e64) into buffer 0x4ce9430 via sub_44A6FB and emits it with sub_40114F, updates the last-position triple [0x4db3800/04/08], and returns 1. Feeds the position-history used by the walk/waypoint recorder.

0x4169e0.name: pileLootStackableItems
0x4169e0.purpose: 'pile loot2' routine (logs the label via sub_40114F). Iterates open containers (base [0x468f2c], stride 0x1ec, end [0x4db377c]); per container it checks the open flag at off +0x34 and item count at off +0x30, then walks each item slot (base off +0x3b + [0x468f5c], per-item stride 0xc) reading the item id (off +1 of slot) and its stack count (off +0) via ReadClientState. When an item's id equals the configured target id [0x468fb0] and its count is between 2 and 99 (a partial stack: >1 and <0x64), and a full-stack reference (count >= 0x64) exists, it calls sub_4012DA with the drag source (container index [ebp-4], slot [ebp-0x1c], id) and stack coords from 0x4ae9d00/04/08, then Sleep([0x468f90]). Merges partial stacks of a configured stackable loot item into full stacks.

0x407867.name: simulateMouseDragTile
0x407867.purpose: Software mouse-drag emulation on the client window. Guarded by [0x4db38e0]==1; formats a 'dragging %d,%d:%d,%d' debug line via sub_44A6FB into buffer 0x4ce9430 and prints it (sub_40114F). Sleeps 10ms, then verifies GetForegroundWindow()==client HWND [0x4d22494] before acting. Saves current cursor (GetCursorPos), SetCursorPos to the source (arg1,arg2), posts WM_LBUTTONDOWN(0x201) with lParam=packed x|(y<<16) via SendMessageA to [0x4d22494], SetCursorPos to dest (arg3,arg4), posts WM_LBUTTONUP(0x202), then restores the saved cursor. Used for drag-and-drop item moves in the client GUI. Bails if arg2<0 or arg4<0.

0x407b09.name: emptyStub407b09
0x407b09.purpose: Empty stub: standard prologue/epilogue (push ebp; mov ebp,esp; pop ebp; ret) with no body. Placeholder/no-op function, likely a compiler-emitted empty handler.

0x407b0e.name: emptyStub407b0e
0x407b0e.purpose: Empty stub: prologue/epilogue only, no body (20 bytes but 4 real insns). No-op placeholder function.

0x407b22.name: checkTargetLostRecently
0x407b22.purpose: Returns whether a target was very recently valid/lost. Gated on [0x4db39b8]!=0 (feature enable) else returns 0. Reads a snapshot scalar [0x4b07b8c] into a local, then ReadClientState([0x468f40],4) and ReadClientState([0x4db3774],4). If the second read==7 (a client state/mode value) and the first read equals the [0x4b07b8c] snapshot, it timestamps via sub_44A7A8 (clock) into [0x4db39bc] and returns 1 only while (clock() - [0x4db39bc]) < 0x1f4 (500 ms); otherwise 0. Acts as a short debounce window keyed on client field [0x468f40]/[0x4db3774].

0x407b9c.name: creatureLookupField4cById
0x407b9c.purpose: Linear scan of the client creature array (base [0x468f38], stride 0xe0, end [0x4db37ac]). For each entry it ReadClientState((entry-4),4) to get the creature id and compares to arg1; on match it ReadClientState((entry+0x4c),4) and returns that field (creature attribute at +0x4c, e.g. a flag/skull). Returns 0 if not found. The +0x4c offset distinguishes it from the +0x34/+0x88 sibling lookups below.

0x407c00.name: creatureLookupField34ById
0x407c00.purpose: Same creature-array scan as creatureLookupField4cById (base [0x468f38], stride 0xe0, id at entry-4) but on an id match returns ReadClientState((entry+0x34),4) — creature attribute at +0x34. Returns 1 (not 0) as the not-found sentinel, so +0x34 is a field whose 0/absent case the caller treats specially.

0x407c67.name: creatureLookupField88ById
0x407c67.purpose: Same creature-array scan (base [0x468f38], stride 0xe0, id at entry-4). On id==arg1 match returns ReadClientState((entry+0x88),4) — creature attribute at +0x88 (matches the +0x88 'hp/percent-like' field read elsewhere). Not-found sentinel is 0x64 (100), consistent with +0x88 being a health-percent field defaulting to full.

0x407cd1.name: trackSelfPositionHistory
0x407cd1.purpose: Self-position change tracker / stuck-detector ring buffer. Reads current self coords: x=ReadClientState([0x4db372c]), y=ReadClientState([0x4db3728]), z=ReadClientState([0x468f30]) into 0x4cfd2f4/0x4cfd2f0/0x4cfd2ec. If unchanged from last coords [0x4afd520]/[0x4afd51c]/[0x4afd518] returns 1. On any change it increments a monotonic counter [0x4b032e4] and writes the new x,y,z into three parallel ring buffers indexed by (counter mod 0x7d0=2000): [0x4b013a4] (x), [0x4aff464] (y), [0x4afd524] (z). If only the floor (z) stayed the same and [0x4db38bc]==0 it instead stores marker 1 in the x-ring and [0x4db3974] in the y-ring (teleport/level-transition marker). Updates last-coords and returns 1 on change, 0 if identical.

0x407e11.name: computeTargetScreenX
0x407e11.purpose: Computes a screen/grid X coordinate for a creature relative to self. Reads self x=[0x4db372c], self y=[0x4db3728], a target-x-ish field [0x4db37c0], and a creature-base pointer chain: base=[0x4db3708], node=ReadClientState(base+0x30); then reads node+0x0 (px), +0x4, +0x8, +0xc, +0x3c (span), +0x34 (lo), +0x38 (added to +0x34 => hi). Interpolates: result = selfX + ( (px - lo)*0xf / (hi - lo) ) - 7. This maps a client viewport pixel/offset into a 15-wide (0xf) tile grid centered so self sits near column 7. Screen-to-map X projection used for click/aim targeting.

0x407f2a.name: computeTargetScreenY
0x407f2a.purpose: Y-axis counterpart of computeTargetScreenX. Reads self x=[0x4db372c], self y=[0x4db3728], target-y field [0x4db37bc], creature-base [0x4db3708]->+0x30 node, and node fields +0x0/+4/+8/+0xc/+0x3c/+0x34/+0x38. Computes result = selfY + (fieldC*0xb / span) - 5, projecting a client viewport value into an 11-tall (0xb) tile grid with self near row 5. Paired with 0x407e11 to produce (x,y) screen/map coords for aiming.

0x40803b.name: walkPathToCreatureClick
0x40803b.purpose: Pathfind-and-click walker toward a creature id (arg1). Debounces via [0x4db39c0]/[0x4db39c4] (a 6-slot mod counter that suppresses repeats up to 5 iterations, reset when the id changes via sub_4011BD write to [0x468f34]). Loads self pos [0x4db372c]/[0x4db3728] plus offset fields [0x4db37b4]/[0x4db37b0] and a floor field [0x4db3784]. First loop finds the self entry in the creature array (base [0x468f38], stride 0xe0) to read viewport offsets +0x30/+0x2c. Second loop finds the target id entry, reads its map coords +0x28/+0x24, computes dx/dy vs self and calls sub_40143D (abs/clamp) to get a Chebyshev distance clamped to 7; walks a stepwise path checking each intervening tile's creature-base (+0x30 chain, fields +8 id==0x63 blocker / +4) for obstacles, bailing (return 0) if a blocking creature (id 0x63) sits in the path. When a clear adjacent screen cell is found it computes pixel coords via the (x*0x1e/... ,y*0x16/...) viewport formulas, calls sub_401014 (mouse button state) and sub_401343, and posts WM_MOUSEMOVE(0x100)/related SendMessageA to click-walk toward the target, Sleep(10), stores id in [0x4db39c0]. Returns 1 when it acted/queued, 0 on blocked/failed.

0x4084e4.name: setActiveContainerItemId
0x4084e4.purpose: Tiny setter: copies [0x468fd0] (a currently-selected/target item-id client field) into [0x4afd494], the 'active item id' slot that the ssaa/potion loops compare against (see [0x4afd494] use in 0x40850c). Snapshots the selected item for the following action pass.

0x4084fd.name: stampActionClock490
0x4084fd.purpose: Timestamp helper: calls sub_44A7A8 (clock()/GetTickCount) and stores the result in [0x4afd490], a last-action timestamp slot used for a cooldown/throttle window. Two-line stamp function.

0x40850c.name: cavebotHealSafetyTick
0x40850c.purpose: Large per-tick engine loop combining anti-idle, PZ/attack watch, HP/mana healing and the 'ssaa' friend-follow logic. Reads self x=[0x4db372c], y=[0x4db3728], z=[0x468f30]; bumps loop counter [0x4db3a40]; runs a ~1s parity toggle [0x4db39c8]/[0x4db39cc] (clock via sub_44A7A8) feeding a per-second action gate [0x4db3a00]. Reads a status byte [0x4db379c]; while the master enable [0x469098]==0 and warmed up it computes a decoy value (([0x4db39e0]/2)+0x4bb vs [0x4db39e4]) and early-returns. Detects PZ transitions ([0x4db379c] bit 0x80 with [0x4db39d0]) and prints 'PZ Gone' (sub_4010DC/sub_401050) then Sleeps [0x4afd380]. Loads HP-current [0x4db3794], HP-max [0x4db3798], mana [0x4db37a8], and a level/cap field [0x4db37b8]; clamps mana to 0xffff, computes hp% = hpcur*100/hpmax and mana%. Scans the battle/message list ([0x468f44] via sub_401370) with sub_44AF30 for 'due to an attack by' and, gated by [0x4db3838]/[0x469050]/[0x4db3884] and a 5000ms cooldown [0x4db3a48], builds an '*%s*%s' auto-reply via sub_44A6FB and sends it (sub_401320); optionally casts 'utamo vita' (sub_401398) when [0x4db39e8]==1. The 'ssaa' branch (gated [0x4db39f0], cooldown [0x4690a8], container base [0x468f2c] stride 0x1ec) walks open containers matching item [0x4afd494] and fires sub_40123F ('ssaa loaded'). The remaining body (hp%/mana% vs thresholds [0x4690c4], flag [0x4db3844]/[0x4db3848]/[0x4db3a04]/[0x4db3a08]) selects heal spells/potions and injects them. Central heal+safety driver; returns 1 to keep the tick alive.

0x40a10d.name: potionOnFriendTick
0x40a10d.purpose: '!potion!' friend/self potion-use pass. Reads follow-id [0x4db3784], self x=[0x4db372c], y=[0x4db3728], z=[0x468f30]. First creature-array loop (base [0x468f38], stride 0xe0, id at entry-4) locates the follow target; reads entry+0x4c (a flag) and, when set and [0x4690b8]==0, aborts (return 0) — a guard that skips potioning under some condition. Second loop rescans the array to select potion recipients; formats debug 'testing potioning:%x' / 'used !potion! on:%x' via sub_44A6FB and prints (sub_40114F). Uses sub_44ACF5 (abs distance) to range-check recipients vs self, sub_401339 to emit the use-on-creature action, and sub_401041/sub_40143D helpers. Applies configured potion to friends within range each tick.

0x40a3b5.name: autoAttackNearestTick
0x40a3b5.purpose: Auto-target/auto-attack engine tick. Gated: if [0x4db390c]==0 && [0x4db3a58]==0 return 1 (disabled); if sub_40145B()==1 (some busy/blocked state) return 1. Handles a re-attack path: when arg1==1 and the current client target [0x468f34]==saved [0x4db3a60] and attack-mode [0x4db3a58]==1, it re-issues MB_SendAction(0,0xA1) (sub_401217, ATTACK opcode) and writes the target back via sub_4011BD to [0x468f34]. Otherwise records arg1 as target into [0x4db3a60], loads follow-id [0x4db3784], self x=[0x4db372c]/y=[0x4db3728]/z=[0x468f30], and scans the creature array (base [0x468f38], stride 0xe0) skipping self and the follow-id, matching arg1. On the matched creature it reads +0x20 (floor must equal self z), +0x88 (hp>=1 else skip), the -1 byte, and map coords +0x28/+0x24; uses sub_44ACF5 to require dx<=7 && dy<=5. Computes an aggression ratio hp%([0x4db3790])*100/(mana+1 [0x4db37a8]); when >0x28 and arg2 set it flags [0x4db39f8] and, if within 2 sqm, stamps clocks [0x4db39fc]. Finally, when in range and attack armed ([0x4db3a58]/[0x4db3a54]), issues MB_SendAction(target,0xA1) via sub_401217, writes target to [0x468f34] (sub_4011BD), optionally calls sub_401339 (turn/face) when [0x4db390c]==1, Sleep(0x32), and stamps [0x4db3a64]. Returns 1 on attack issued, 0 when no valid target/out of range.

0x41899b.name: exploreStepPlanner
0x41899b.purpose: Anti-stuck explore/pathfinding tick. Reads self x/y/z via MB_ReadClientState (0x4db372c,0x4db3728,0x468f30), compares to last-seen coords at 0xdd9ba0/ba4/ba8 and to a stuck-tracking triple 0xdd9b94/98/9c. On position change decrements the walk-budget timer 0x469290 by 0x12c. Maintains the current target/self tile scalars 0x469278/0x46927c/0x469280 (x/y/z) clamped to the visible band [0x14..0x3d4] x, [1..0xb] z; Beeps (200Hz) once via [0x5c5d548] and re-syncs when out of range. Builds candidate step tiles into a stack array (stride 0xc: dx,dy,z) around the target, then scores them against precomputed neighbor-offset tables 0x4ae8328 (x), 0x4ae7388 (y), 0x4ae63e8 (z) using sub_44ACF5 (abs) to compute a Manhattan cost, seeding rand via sub_44ADB6. Logs 'Doing quicktest:%d' and 'New explore %d %d %d:%d' through sub_44A6FB(sprintf)+sub_40114F(status). Reads waypoint list 0x4da3d00 indexed by 0x4db3c54, current waypoint index 0x4db3818, and flags 0x4db3c14/c24/c38/c58/c60 driving the explore state machine.

0x419c8c.name: waypointWalker
0x419c8c.purpose: Main waypoint follower / walk driver ('Near z change waypoint'). Reads self x/y/z and stance via MB_ReadClientState (0x4db372c=x,0x4db3728=y,0x468f30=z, plus 0x4db3790/98/94 hp-ratio guard against 0x4afd388). Walks the waypoint array at base 0x4da3cf8 (x)/0x4da3cfc (y)/0x4da3d00 (z), stride 0x10, indexed by 0x4db3818; caches current waypoint into 0x4db3c78/7c and previous-index into 0xdd9b8c. For each pending waypoint it computes a direction byte into a local buffer (1=north via sub +? , 3/5/7 for the other axes by comparing self tile 0x469278/7c to waypoint coords), validates the built step string with sub_44A680(strlen) and dispatches it through sub_40146A (send-walk/step emitter). Handles z-change waypoints (skip/advance when 0x4da3d00 z differs), reached-target detection (0x4db3c78/7c match within 0x384/0x578 ms of stamp 0x4db3c8c), and paced retries via Sleep(0x14). Honors pause counter 0x4db3b44 and diagonal-corner smoothing when 0x4db3c5c set. Sets progress flags 0x4db3c58/c60 and stamp timer sub_44A7A8.

0x41bafa.name: scanBattleListForUse
0x41bafa.purpose: Obfuscation-gated sweep over the entity/battle-list array. Entry gate: xor 0x4db3c94 with 0x251, multiply by 0x4db3c90 and 0xc7, take mod 100; only proceeds when remainder==0x1b, and requires enable flag 0x4db3c9c!=0, writing marker 0x659340 into 0x469298. Reads two client scalars via MB_ReadClientState (0x4db3768, 0x4db3770) that bound a valid count [2..9]. Then walks the record array based at client pointer 0x468f2c, stride 0x1ec, up to limit 0x4db377c: for each record it reads the +0x34 active flag and +0x30 sub-count, and for each sub-entry reads id at (base+0x468f5c+0x3b + i*0xc +1) and a second field at +0x40. When the id matches the target in ebp-0xc it calls sub_40123F (MB_SendAction, opcode 0xa payload) to fire an action on that entry, then Sleep(0x468f90 ms). Effectively a rune/spell-on-target dispatcher keyed off the polled entity list.

0x41bc76.name: containerFoodUseLoop
0x41bc76.purpose: Throttled container-slot use loop (eat-food / consumable spam). Gated by counter 0x4db3c90<0x4f (clears 0x46929c) and enable flag 0x4db3c98!=0; rate-limited to once per 0x186a0 (100000) ms via last-fire stamp 0x4db3834 (sub_44A7A8=GetTickCount). Iterates the container array at client base 0x468f2c stride 0x1ec up to 0x4db377c, reading +0x34 (open flag) and +0x30 (item count) per container, and each slot's item id at (base+0x468f5c+0x3b + slot*0xc +1). For an id that passes the predicate sub_4011D1 it invokes sub_40112C (MB_SendAction use-item) three times with Sleep(0x64) between each, then re-stamps 0x4db3834 and prints status via sub_40114F. The triple-use with 100ms spacing is a use-food/consumable action.

0x41c274.name: healerAndReloader
0x41c274.purpose: HP%/mana% healer plus ammo/spear reload routine. Computes hp% from max 0x4db37a8 vs current 0x4db3790 and mana ratio from 0x4db3798*100/0x4db3794 (all via MB_ReadClientState); pauses and prints 'HP is below your light healing %, Pausing' (sub_4010DC) when hp falls under the configured light-heal threshold (compared against ebp-0x10c scaled by 0x50/100). Scans the container array (base 0x468f2c, stride 0x1ec, limit 0x4db377c; slots via 0x468f5c) for specific item ids: 0xc4b, spear ids 0xccd/0x1cc7 (checked with the 'exeta con' string compare sub_44A4D0 and logs 'spear loaded'), and food/consumable ids 0xdfe,0xdf9,0xe8b,0xdff,0xdfa,0xe8d,0xe16. On a match it fires sub_40123F/sub_40112C (MB_SendAction use/move-item, opcodes 5 and 0xa) with Sleep(0x468f90) pacing, guarded by gate 0x4db38a0/0x4db3878 and a rate stamp 0x4db3cac / 0x4db3834. sub_44A680(strlen)/sub_401398 manage the exeta-con string buffers 0x4caa2ac/0x4d22410.

0x41cc90.name: applyClientPatchTable
0x41cc90.purpose: Installs the in-client memory patches (self-modifying the Tibia process). Saves/clears the enable gate 0x469098, then reads the patch-table bounds via MB_ReadClientState (start 0x4db37c4, end 0x468eec) and computes entry count = (end-start)/0x30. For each 0x30-stride entry it reads a length field at +0x18: if <0x10 the bytes are inline at the record, else a pointer at +4; it runs the bytes through sub_401370, copies into scratch 0xdd9a50 via sub_4013BB, and writes them into the target with sub_4011BD (MB_WriteMem) at the address held in +0x14, and a second block at +0x28 using scratch 0xdd9a1c. Finally calls VirtualProtectEx ([0x5c5d570]) on handle 0x4d22464 / address 0x468f3c to flip page protection around the final patch (restored via sub_4013BB), sets patched flag 0x4db3918=1 and restores 0x469098. Returns 1.

0x41ce04.name: isClientPatched
0x41ce04.purpose: Reports whether the packet.dll/client patch is already applied. Returns 1 immediately if the patched flag 0x4db3918==1. Otherwise reads one byte at client address 0x468f3c and one at 0x468f3c+1 via MB_ReadClientState(size 1) and returns 1 only if they equal the signature bytes 0x31 ('1') and 0x30 ('0') respectively; returns 0 when the signature is absent. Used as the guard before applyClientPatchTable re-patches.

0x4369e2.name: initLuaStateAndRegisterApi
0x4369e2.purpose: Boots the MageBot Lua VM and registers the MB_* global C-function API. Zeroes a runtime flag at 0x4db3e60, calls luaL_newstate() and stores the lua_State* in the global at [0x61d5e0], then luaL_openlibs() on it. It then performs the standard register-pair pattern repeated ~30+ times: lua_pushcclosure(L, <handler>, 0) followed by lua_setfield(L, LUA_GLOBALSINDEX=0xffffd8ee, <name>) to install each global. Handlers live in the 0x401xxx/0x437xxx band and names in the 0x46e3xx-0x46e5xx string band; registered globals include DrawText(0x437688), SetTimerCallback(0x4375f6), printtext(0x43776a), IsKeyDown(0x40119a), GetCursorX/Y(0x4014d3/0x40146f), PrintError(0x401190), ReloadLua(0x401131), LoadFile/SaveFile(0x4014c9/0x40118b), GetScriptInfo(0x4013ac), EnableScript/DisableScript(0x40141a/0x4013a2), GetClock(0x4014ce), ListScripts(0x40127b), GetScriptNumber(0x40122b), GetMaxContainers(0x4014dd), GetContainerItems(0x4012d0), UseInventoryItem/UseContainerItem/UseSpell/UseGroundItem/UseItemOnGround, Start/Stop/ClearWaypoints and waypoint/MoveTo/AutoExplorer helpers. Precedes registration with a call to sub_44A750 (memset/init over 0x3a0c0 bytes at 0x5e3520, the script-table backing store). This is the Lua-API installer feeding the 63-global MB_* surface.

0x4377b4.name: dispatchTimerCallbacks
0x4377b4.purpose: Iterates the per-script timer-callback tables and fires each registered timer into Lua via the 'dotimercallback' global handler. Wrapped in an SEH frame (fs:[0] handler at 0x4641da). Outer loop index at [ebp-0x14] walks scripts up to either 1 or the script-count global [0x4db3e60] (gated by flag [0x4db3e64]); inner index [ebp-0x18] walks entries whose count sits at [script*0xb9c + 0x5e40b0]. Per entry it computes the callback-id string pointer at base (script*0xb9c) + (entry<<8) + 0x5e36b0, records current script index into [0x4db3e54], saves lua_gettop, does lua_getfield(L, GLOBALS, "dotimercallback"), pushes the callback-id string (lua_pushstring) and the script index as a number (lua_pushnumber), then lua_pcall(L, 2 args, 1 result, 0). On pcall error it reads the error via lua_tolstring, formats it into the 0x5e3420 buffer with sub_44A590, emits it through sub_4013F7 (error/print sink), sets crash flag [0x4db3e78]=1, resets the stack with lua_settop, and calls sub_401424 (disable/cleanup). The non-error tail also builds a "%s crash:%s" message via sub_44A6FB from the script name at (script*0xb9c)+0x5e3520 and routes it through sub_4013F7. Backs the SetTimerCallback/dotimercallback Lua timer subsystem.

0x416b26.name: cavebotWalkToWaypointTarget
0x416b26.purpose: Cavebot/waypoint walk step: after formatting a debug line via sub_44A6FB into buffer 0x4ce9430 and logging it with sub_40114F (using waypoint index [0x4db3820]), it iterates the container/creature record array from base [0x468f2c] in 0x1ec (492)-byte strides up to limit [0x4db377c], reading each record's active flag (+0x34), sub-count (+0x30), and per-entry id/type fields via ReadClientState (sub_4011B8) at offsets built from the field-base globals [0x468f5c]/[0x468f60]/[0x468f64] (+0x3b + entry*0xc, +0x40, +0x3c). It matches a target creature id against [0x468fb0] with entry value in [1..0x64), and on a hit calls the walk/step builder sub_4012DA with the resolved coords plus self-position scalars [0x4db3858]/[0x4db385c]/[0x4db3860] and waypoint counter [0x4db386c]. A second pass (gated on [0x4db386c]==1) filters entry ids through a hardcoded skip set (0xEA,0xF0,0x11A,0x11E,0x10A,0x10C — non-walkable/creature tile types), calls sub_40112C/sub_4011C7 (dir helpers), then issues movement frames through sub_401208 and sub_40123F, throttling each phase with Sleep on sub-fields of the timing table [0x468f90] (+0x64,+0xc8,+0x190,+0x1f4). Maintains retry state [0x4db3bd4] and stall marker [0x4db3bdc]=0xFFFFFFF6.

0x41701b.name: cavebotWalkToWaypointTargetGuarded
0x41701b.purpose: Larger sibling of cavebotWalkToWaypointTarget (0x416b26): a waypoint/cavebot walk-and-approach routine keyed on takes-arg [ebp+8] (waypoint/label index used to index the per-waypoint stuck counter array 0x4db3be0). Bails immediately if global-disable [0x4db3820]==1. First scans the record array (base [0x468f2c], 0x1ec stride, limit [0x4db377c]) reading active(+0x34)/count(+0x30) and entry fields (via bases [0x468f5c]/[0x468f64]) through ReadClientState, matching creature id vs [0x468fb0]; when mode [0x4db3894]!=1 it enforces a 0x3a98 (15000ms) dwell using timer sub_44A7A8 vs [0x4db3c08]. It counts still-present targets, aborting with [0x4db3c0c]++ if the expected target count [ebp-0x20] mismatches. A tile-type pass filters the same skip set (0xEA/0xF0/0x11A/0x11E/0x10A/0x10C) and clamps a min-distance/priority into [0x4db3c10] (floored to 3), honoring stand-still flag [0x4db3878]. The approach step computes a wrapped direction: ((stuckCtr[idx] / 0x14) + [0x4db386c]) mod 0x14, then calls the move builder sub_40123F and increments stuckCtr[idx]. Uses sub_40112C/sub_4011C7 dir helpers, sub_401208 send, and Sleeps on [0x468f90] sub-offsets. Returns 1 on stuck/abort. (asm tail truncated in sample; late blocks unconfirmed.)

0x417c33.name: buildPathToTileFloodFill
0x417c33.purpose: Pathfinding entry (walk-to X,Y from current X,Y; args [ebp+8]=destX,[ebp+0xc]=destY,[ebp+0x10]=srcX,[ebp+0x14]=srcY). Increments call counter [0x4db3c28]; reads a config field via ReadClientState from [0x4db3784] into a step-cost var. Throttles a retry budget [0x4db3c30] every 0x190 (400ms) using timer sub_44A7A8 vs [0x4db3c34]. Fast-outs: returns 1 if src==dst, returns 0 if |dx|>9 or <-8 or |dy|>7 or <-6 (out of a bounded reach window). Checks a precomputed reachable-tile cache (parallel arrays 0x4ae99e0=X, 0x4ae96c0=Y, 0x4ae93a0=result) when both [0x4db3c14]/[0x4db3c18] modes are 0, bumping hit counter [0x4db3c2c]. Otherwise calls sub_40143D (path-node allocator/expander) with (dx,dy), reads its node table (stride [0x468f6c] from base+0x2c), and per node reads type(+8) and id(+4) via ReadClientState. Node type 0x63 is the goal/self marker; tile ids are looked up in the walkability table 0x4d38814 (bit 0x80000001 = blocked). Records special blocking creatures into avoid-lists 0x4ae8400(X)/0x4ae7460(Y)/0x4ae64c0(dir) keyed on [0x4db3c24], and reads a second obstacle map 0x4da04c4/0x4da04c0 (16-byte stride). Special item ids (0x15a6,0x79c,0x7b0,0x182,0x1a5,0x2faa,0x1b3,0x79d) get direction-tagged. Returns 1 if a walkable path/tile is found, 0 otherwise. Uses abs() sub_44ACF5 with reach margin [0x469054].

0x41814e.name: floodFillReachabilityStep
0x41814e.purpose: Flood-fill / BFS expansion step over the 3D map grid, exploring toward a goal (args: [ebp+8]=goalX,[ebp+0xc]=goalY,[ebp+0x10]=curX,[ebp+0x14]=curY,[ebp+0x18]=selfX,[ebp+0x1c]=selfY). Increments visited counter [0x4db3b40]; records the current tile into the visited-list arrays 0x4aeb7e4(X)/0x4aeb1a4(Y) at index [0x4db3b3c]. Returns 1 if cur==goal (path found). Aborts (return 0) if visited count exceeds 0x5a (90 nodes) or list cap [0x469114]. When distance-limit mode [0x4db3c38] is set, it bounds the walk to |dx|<8,|dy|<6 relative to self and reads the region-grid array (floor [ebp+0x10]*0x3d0900 + x*0xfa0 + y*4 + base 0xddc2c0) to reject already-marked tiles; on first call it memsets a 0xa80-byte local visited bitmap 0x4ae5a40 via sub_44A750. Calls walkability check sub_401032 (blocked test) before recursing. Computes step direction signs toward the goal (setge/branch tricks), preferring the axis with larger abs-delta (via sub_44ACF5), then recurses into sub_401410 (the recursive neighbor-visit / A* expander) with the advanced (x+dx,y+dy). On success and re-entry flag [0x4db3c3c], loops a 2x2/4-neighborhood block. This is the core reachability recursion behind buildPathToTileFloodFill.

0x41865a.name: gridTileCostLookup
0x41865a.purpose: Map-grid tile cost/value accessor with axis-clamp (args [ebp+8]=x,[ebp+0xc]=y,[ebp+0x10]=floor). If |x-0x1f4| exceeds reach limit [0x469284] it returns a timestamped fallback (clock() sub_44A7A8 + abs(x-0x1f4)*0x3e8); same clamp for y. 0x1f4 (500) is the grid-center origin, so x,y are absolute map coords offset around 500. In-bounds it indexes the 3D grid array floor*0x3d0900 + x*0xfa0 + y*4 + base 0xddc2c0 and returns that cell's stored value/cost. The tail (2x2 averaging loop over neighbors [ebp-8]/[ebp-0x14], summing grid cells with sub-offset multipliers [ebp-0xc]/[ebp-0x10], then dividing the accumulator by 4 with rounding via cdq/and 3) computes a smoothed/averaged tile cost over a small neighborhood. Reads only the map-grid mirror at 0xddc2c0; no packet built.

0x418786.name: gridMarkPathAndRecurse
0x418786.purpose: Recursive path-marking / reachability writer over the 3D map grid (args [ebp+8]=x,[ebp+0xc]=y,[ebp+0x10]=floor,[ebp+0x14]=marker/depth,[ebp+0x18]=selfX-base,[ebp+0x1c]=selfY-base). Aborts (return 0) if global recursion depth [0x4db3c50] exceeds [0x469288], or if the current grid cell (floor*0x3d0900 + x*0xfa0 + y*4 + 0xddc2c0) already holds a value > marker-2, or if |x-selfBase|>7 / |y-selfBase|>5 (bounded reach box around [0x469278]/[0x46927c] self coords). On first entry ([0x4db3c50]==0) it seeds an 8x6 neighborhood (dx -7..8, dy -5..6): for each open tile (walkability sub_401032==0) it writes the marker into the grid, expanding the reachable region. It writes marker-1 into the current cell, increments depth [0x4db3c50], then recurses over the 4-neighborhood (dx,dy in -1..1) via sub_4013E8 (the neighbor-step callback), decrements depth, and returns 1. This is the grid mutator that flood-marks walkable tiles for the pathfinder; it writes the map-grid mirror at 0xddc2c0 and reads self position [0x469278]/[0x46927c].

0x4060b5.name: buildUseOnCreatureFrame
0x4060b5.purpose: Builds a 0x10-byte MB frame with opcode byte 0xD3 (use-item-on-creature) into the frame buffer via sub_401415. Reads the self/player creature id from the RPM creature cache: loads [0x4db3784] then sub_4011B8(ptr,4) to get the local creature id, then walks the creature table starting at base [0x468f38], stride 0xE0, bounded by [0x4db37ac], comparing each entry's field +0x68 (creature id) against arg_0 (target id). On match it reads fields +0x5c and +0x70 (item/stack params via sub_4011B8) and emits frame bytes {0x08,0x00,0xD3, param_5c&0xff,0x00, targetId&0xff x3, param_70&0xff}. Returns 1 always. sub_4011B8 is the RPM byte-band reader; [0x468f38]/[0x4db37ac] are the creature-cache base/end.

0x4061d1.name: driveClientArrowWalkOrDrag
0x4061d1.purpose: Enable-gated ([0x469098]==1) routine that physically drives the real Tibia client window (HWND [0x4d22494]) for directional walk/drag. Calls GetWindowRect, aborts if window off-screen (top < 0xfffff060). Depending on arg_c (direction code 0xA or 0x5) it computes a screen slot from the window rect (height - 0xb4), converts world->screen X via sub_4010F5 and applies the 0x26/0x23/0x1e tile-pitch math, then calls drag helpers sub_401299 (drag) with Sleep(0xa) and posts WM_CHAR-like SendMessageA(0x290). Bounds-checks against sub_4012B2 (screen extent) and re-derives direction from sub_44ADB6. Falls through to emitting a 0x18-byte MB frame opcode 0x78 (move/drag item, x/y/count fields from args) via sub_401415. Uses 0x4014FB (world-coord normalize). Returns 0 on out-of-bounds, 1 on success.

0x40656b.name: buildMoveItemFrame
0x40656b.purpose: Builds a 0x18-byte MB frame with opcode 0x78 (move/throw item, from-slot to-slot with count) via sub_401415, with no client-window interaction. Packs frame bytes {0x0f,0x00,0x78,0xff,0xff, arg8&0xff,0x00, argInt14(count low byte), arg10&0xff, (arg10>>8)&0xff, count,0xff,0xff, argC&0xff,0x00, arg1c&0xff, arg18&0xff}. This is the pure-frame variant of the 0x78 move opcode used by 0x4061d1's fallthrough. Returns 1.

0x406600.name: driveClientDragItemBetweenTiles
0x406600.purpose: Enable-gated ([0x469098]==1) item-drag between two map tiles by driving the client window (HWND [0x4d22494]). Reads self position/offset scalars from the 0x4db37xx RPM band: [0x4db3784] self-id, [0x4db372c]+[0x4db37b4] combined X base, [0x4db3728]+[0x4db37b0] combined Y base (each via sub_4011B8). Walks the creature/tile table from [0x468f38] stride 0xE0 end [0x4db37ac] to locate self, then reads tile fields +0x2c/+0x30 (self map x/y) and a container/tile-object block at [0x4db3708] (+0x30,+0x34,+0x38,+0x3c) to compute pixel drag source/dest with the 0x1e-wide / 0x16-tall viewport tile math (30x22 game view). Issues GetWindowRect, sub_4010F5 screen conversion, drag via sub_401299, Sleep(0xa). Special-cases target-object id 0xda4 and compares against [0x468fb0]; posts SendMessageA(0x290). Fallthrough builds a 0x18-byte MB frame opcode 0x78 via sub_401415. Returns 1/0.

0x4069b8.name: buildMoveItemToContainerFrame
0x4069b8.purpose: Builds a 0x18-byte MB frame opcode 0x78 variant with sub-type byte 0x02 (move item into container/backpack slot) via sub_401415; aborts (returns 1) if arg_18==0. Packs {0x0f,0x00,0x78, argC low, argC high, arg10 low, arg10 high, arg14 low, arg18 low, arg18 high, 0x02,0xff,0xff, (arg8+0x40) low,0x00, arg1c low, arg20 low}. A no-window pure-frame move-item builder distinguished from 0x40656b by the 0x02 discriminator and the two 16-bit coordinate pairs.

0x406a70.name: buildMoveItemToSlotFrame
0x406a70.purpose: Builds a 0x18-byte MB frame opcode 0x78 variant with sub-type byte 0x01 (move item to inventory equip slot) via sub_401415; aborts (returns 1) if arg_20==0.
