Packs 16-bit x/y pairs from arg8/argC/arg10 and target arg20, the 0x01 discriminator, plus arg14/arg18/arg1c fields. Sibling of 0x4069b8 (0x02 variant); both are pure frame builders for the item-move opcode 0x78.

0x406b4e.name: driveClientLeftClickTile
0x406b4e.purpose: Enable-gated ([0x469098]==1) left-click-on-map-tile routine. Reads self coords from the 0x4db37xx RPM band ([0x4db3784] id, [0x4db372c]+[0x4db37b4] X, [0x4db3728]+[0x4db37b0] Y via sub_4011B8), walks creature table [0x468f38] stride 0xE0 end [0x4db37ac] to find self and read tile +0x2c/+0x30, then reads the map-object block at [0x4db3708] to project a world tile to a viewport pixel using the 30-wide(0x1e)/22-tall(0x16) tile math with rounding. Validates pixel is inside the game viewport bounds. Calls sub_401014 (foreground/focus check), SendMessageA(0x100 WM_KEYDOWN + modifier 0x11=CTRL), then sub_401343 (left-click at x,y), then SendMessageA(0x101 WM_KEYUP) and Sleep(0xa). Fallthrough builds a 0x10-byte MB frame opcode 0x82 (map-click/look) via sub_401415. Returns 1/0.

0x406e98.name: driveClientUseInventorySlot
0x406e98.purpose: Enable-gated ([0x469098]==1) inventory-slot use/click. Normalizes arg_8 slot via sub_4014FB, GetWindowRect for HWND [0x4d22494], computes a fixed screen Y from window height minus 0x11 (inventory panel row), converts the slot to X via sub_4010F5 (+8 offset), then sub_401276 performs the click there; Sleep(0xa). Fallthrough builds an 8-byte MB frame opcode 0x87 (use inventory item, slot in low byte) via sub_401415. Returns 1. Aborts early returning 1 if arg_8<0.

0x406f48.name: buildUseInventorySlotFrame
0x406f48.purpose: Builds an 8-byte MB frame opcode 0x88 (inventory slot action, one variant up from 0x87) via sub_401415: {0x02,0x00,0x88, arg8&0xff,0,0,0,0}. Pure-frame sibling of 0x406e98 with no client-window drive. Returns 1.

0x406f88.name: buildUseHotkeyItemFrame
0x406f88.purpose: Builds a 0x10-byte MB frame opcode 0x82 (use item / map action) via sub_401415, packing a 16-bit coordinate from argC (low/high bytes), a byte from arg8, arg10, and a conditional last byte computed as (arg8 - -0x40) neg/sbb mask & arg8 (a clamp yielding arg8 when arg8+0x40 sets carry). No window interaction; pure frame builder companion to 0x406b4e/0x406ff9 opcode 0x82 family. Returns 1.

0x406ff9.name: driveClientLeftClickCreature
0x406ff9.purpose: Enable-gated ([0x469098]==1) left-click-on-creature routine (targeting/looking). Normalizes arg_8 via sub_4014FB; if arg_10>3 uses sub_4010F5 + 0x23 tile-pitch and bounds-checks against sub_4012B2, returning 0 if off-screen. GetWindowRect + GetForegroundWindow (saves fg HWND), computes screen-Y slot (height-0xb4). Calls sub_401014 (focus/foreground gate) then, if focused, SendMessageA(0x100 WM_KEYDOWN, modifier 0x11=CTRL), sub_401343 left-click at the projected pixel, SendMessageA(0x101 WM_KEYUP), Sleep(0xa). Fallthrough builds a 0x10-byte MB frame opcode 0x82 with the same conditional clamp byte as 0x406f88. Returns 1/0.

0x407254.name: clientPressKeyOnce
0x407254.purpose: Posts a single key press to the Tibia client window (HWND [0x4d22494]): SendMessageA(WM_KEYDOWN=0x100, vk=arg_8) then SendMessageA(WM_KEYUP=0x101, vk=arg_8), Sleep(0xa). No enable gate, no frame building. Low-level key tap primitive used by the higher-level input routines.

0x407425.name: clientPressTwoKeyChord
0x407425.purpose: Posts a two-key chord to the client window (HWND [0x4d22494]): WM_KEYDOWN(argC) then WM_KEYDOWN(arg8), then WM_KEYUP(arg8) then WM_KEYUP(argC), Sleep(0x5a). Used for modifier+key combos (e.g. hold arg_c as modifier, tap arg_8). Longer 90ms settle. No enable gate.

0x407491.name: handleArrowKeyWalk
0x407491.purpose: Core arrow-key walk handler. Formats a debug string "sendkey %x" (0x469848) with arg_8 into buffer 0x4ce9430 via sub_44A6FB then logs via sub_40114F. Branches on arrow VK: 0x27=right/"right", 0x25=left/"left", 0x26=up, 0x28=down/"down", adjusting a pending pixel-step accumulator by [0x468f68] (tile pixel size) and, for diagonals, checking client key-state mirrors [0x4d22448]/[0x4d22444] to correct step. When [0x4db39b0]==1 it validates the destination tile is walkable via sub_401032 using self coords from [0x4db372c]/[0x4db3728] (sub_4011B8 reads); returns 0 if blocked. When direct-walk mode [0x4db3884]==1 it emits raw Tibia walk opcodes via sub_4011F4: 0x65(N),0x66(E? mapped from arrows 0x26->0x65,0x27->0x66,0x28->0x67,0x25->0x68) then Sleep(5). Otherwise sends the key through the client via sub_401163, Sleep(0x32), reads state field via sub_401370 and checks battle/status byte 0x53 and stamina/param [0x4db3730] threshold 0x2d. Returns 1 success / 0 blocked. Also honors gates [0x4db39a8],[0x4db3838],[0x4db39ac].

0x40775e.name: clientMouseMoveDrag
0x40775e.purpose: Posts mouse move-drag messages to the client window (HWND [0x4d22494]) at packed screen coords lParam=(arg8&0xffff)|((argC&0xffff)<<16): SendMessageA(WM_MBUTTONDOWN=0x201) then SendMessageA(WM_MBUTTONUP=0x202), Sleep(0xa). Aborts if argC<0. Middle-button click/drag primitive at a pixel location.

0x4077c9.name: clientRightClickAt
0x4077c9.purpose: Posts a right-click to the client window (HWND [0x4d22494]) at packed screen coords lParam=(arg8&0xffff)|((argC&0xffff)<<16): SendMessageA(WM_RBUTTONDOWN=0x204) then SendMessageA(WM_RBUTTONUP=0x205), Sleep(0xa). Aborts if argC<0. When debug flag [0x4db38e0]==1 it first formats ".=%d %d" (0x469870) with the coords into 0x4ce9430 via sub_44A6FB and logs via sub_40114F. Right-click primitive (context menu / use) at a pixel location.

0x404d2e.name: buildChannelTalkFrame96Sub1
0x404d2e.purpose: Dynamic text-packet builder. Calls sub_44A680 (strlen) on the string arg [ebp+8], adds 4 for the length field, and rejects lengths <4 (except ==4) or >0x80 (returns 1). Lays out a stack frame at [ebp-0x80]: 2-byte total-length word, opcode byte 0x96 at [ebp-0x7e], subtype 0x01 at [ebp-0x7d], then (len-4) as a 2-byte LE string-length word, then copies the string body in via sub_44A590 (memcpy). Rounds the byte count up to the next multiple of 8 ((len+6)/8*8 with sign fixup) and hands the buffer to the pipe-target injector sub_40152D (the addressed variant of the 0x40320a inject primitive). Builds a Tibia 0x96 talk/channel frame with speak-type subtype 1.

0x404e26.name: buildTalkFrame64
0x404e26.purpose: Dynamic text-packet builder for opcode 0x64. strlen(arg[ebp+8]) via sub_44A680, +2, bounds-checked [4..0x80] else returns 1. Frame at [ebp-0x80]: 2-byte length word, opcode 0x64 at [ebp-0x7e], a single subtype byte = (len-2) at [ebp-0x7d], then the string copied via sub_44A590 (memcpy) into [ebp-0x7c]. Byte count rounded up to a multiple of 8 ((len+2)/8*8) and injected via sub_401415 (thunk to 0x40320a inject). 0x64 is the client's map/text describe request shape carrying an inline string.

0x404eee.name: buildChannelTalkFrame96Sub12
0x404eee.purpose: Sibling of 0x404d2e: dynamic 0x96 text-frame builder but with subtype 0x0C instead of 0x01. strlen via sub_44A680, +4, bounds [4..0x80]. Frame at [ebp-0x80]: length word, opcode 0x96, subtype 0x0C at [ebp-0x7d], (len-4) 2-byte string-length word, then string copied via sub_44A590 (memcpy). Rounded to multiple of 8, injected via sub_401415 (0x40320a). 0x96 speak-type 0x0C = a different chat channel/private-message variant of the same talk opcode.

0x404fde.name: buildNpcBuyFrame7A
0x404fde.purpose: NpcBuy builder (documented at engine-core.md as 0x00404fde, opcode 0x7A). Static 8-byte stack frame at [ebp-0x10]: length byte 0x07, 0x00, opcode 0x7A, then item id as 2 LE bytes from arg[ebp+8] (low at [ebp-0xd], high>>8 at [ebp-0xc]), a 0x00 pad, count byte from arg[ebp+0xc] at [ebp-0xa], two trailing 0x00. Pushes len 0x10, buffer, calls sub_401415 (0x40320a inject). Wire payload: 07 00 7A <id:2 LE> 00 <count> 00 00.

0x405039.name: buildNpcSellFrame7B
0x405039.purpose: NpcSell builder (engine-core.md 0x00405039, opcode 0x7B), byte-identical to buildNpcBuyFrame7A except opcode byte 0x7B at [ebp-0xe]. Static frame: length 0x07, 0x00, 0x7B, item id 2 LE bytes from arg[ebp+8], 0x00, count from arg[ebp+0xc], 00 00. Injected via sub_401415 (0x40320a). Wire payload: 07 00 7B <id:2 LE> 00 <count> 00 00.

0x40519d.name: buildOpcode98Frame
0x40519d.purpose: Static 4-byte-payload builder for opcode 0x98. Frame at [ebp-8]: length byte 0x03, 0x00, opcode 0x98 at [ebp-6], then a 2-byte LE value from arg[ebp+8] (low at [ebp-5], high>>8 at [ebp-4]). Pushes len 8, buffer, sub_401415 (0x40320a inject). Returns 0 (unlike the 1-returning builders). Wire payload: 03 00 98 <val:2 LE> — a single-word request opcode (e.g. an open-channel / request-by-id action).

0x405203.name: buildPrivateMessageFrame96Sub6
0x405203.purpose: Dynamic two-string 0x96 talk builder (private message: recipient + body). strlen(arg[ebp+8]) via sub_44A680, +4, bounds [4..0x13e]. Scans the input for a '*' (0x2A) separator up to len-6, splits the buffer there by writing a NUL at [ebp+8+i]. Lays frame at [ebp-0x14c]: length word, opcode 0x96, subtype 0x06, then a 2-byte word for the recipient-name length and copies the recipient part via sub_44A590; then a 2-byte word for the message length and copies the message body via a second sub_44A590. Total rounded to a multiple of 8 and injected via sub_401415 (0x40320a). 0x96 speak-type 6 = private-message-to-player frame with '*'-delimited name/text.

0x4053a4.name: buildCastRuneTargetFrame
0x4053a4.purpose: CastRuneTarget dynamic builder (engine-core.md 0x004053a4). Gated by master-enable [0x469098]==1. Reads live creature-array state through sub_4011B8 (ReadClientState/0x4024a2 RPM helper): compares the target creature id arg[ebp+0xc] against the self/follow id at [0x4db3784]; if not self, writes it back via sub_4011A9 (WriteClientState) at client base [0x468f34]. Walks the on-screen creature slots from [0x4db3738] in 0x30-byte strides looking for a slot whose id == arg[ebp+8] (source) and target arg[ebp+0xc], reading marker/state bytes at +0 and slot-flag table [0x4db3740]; on a matching pair with flag==2 it calls sub_401163(idx+0x70) and returns. On the miss path it pokes client cursor/state at [0x4db3734]+0xa and [0x4db373c]+0xa00 via sub_4011A9, writes the target id at [0x4db3738]+0x28, sets tile-select flag 1 or 2 at [0x4db3740]+0x28, fires sub_401163(0x7A), then builds a fallback static 0x84-subtype frame (opcode 0x0D length, 0x84 FF FF marker, target id 2 LE from arg[ebp+8], stack-position byte from arg[ebp+0x10], and the item/rune id dword from arg[ebp+0xc]) and injects via sub_401415. Clears animation flag [0x4db3890].

0x4055ca.name: buildUseItemOnCreatureFrame84
0x4055ca.purpose: Static 0x84-subtype MOVE/USE builder (use item on a creature/target). Clears [0x4db3890]. Frame at [ebp-0x10]: length 0x0D, 0x00, marker 0x84, FF FF (from/to container magic), 0x40 at [ebp-0xb], 0x00, stack/count byte from arg[ebp+0x10] at [ebp-9], then target-creature id 2 LE bytes from arg[ebp+8], the same [ebp+0x10] byte again at [ebp-6], and the item id dword from arg[ebp+0xc] written through the [ebp-5] pointer. Pushes len 0x10, buffer, sub_401415 (0x40320a inject). The 0x40 at offset differs from 0x4053a4's 0x00 — this is the 'on inventory/creature' variant.

0x405642.name: buildUseItemFrame84Static
0x405642.purpose: Static-buffer twin of buildUseItemOnCreatureFrame84 that writes into the fixed global scratch buffer at 0x4b032e8 instead of the stack, and uses the pipe-target injector sub_40152D (passing the two extra dst args [ebp+0x14],[ebp+0x18]). Clears [0x4db3890]. Buffer 0x4b032e8: 0x0D 00 84 FF FF 00 00 00, then id 2 LE bytes from arg[ebp+8] at +0x4b032f0/f1, subtype byte from arg[ebp+0x10] at 0x4b032f2, and the dword arg[ebp+0xc] stored at 0x4b032f3. Injects 0x10 bytes via sub_40152D. The 0x84 use-item frame emitted to a specific pipe destination.

0x4056e5.name: buildUseOnTileOrCreatureFrame83
0x4056e5.purpose: Large multi-branch use/cast dispatcher, all reads via sub_4011B8 (ReadClientState RPM helper). Branch A: if arg[ebp+8]==[0x469044] (the local-player creature id), walks the container list from base [0x468f2c] in 0x1ec strides up to [0x4db377c], reading slot flags at +0x34/+0x30 and item entries at [0x468f5c]+node+0x3b+idx*0xc; on a slot owned by the local player it computes screen coords, calls sub_4012DA with the derived args, Sleep(0x8C), and toggles a two-step state [ebp-0x20]. Branch B (else, gated by [0x469098]==1): pokes cursor state [0x4db3734]+0xa / [0x4db373c]+0xa00, writes target id at [0x4db3738]+0x28 via sub_4011A9, sets select flag 0/2 at [0x4db3740]+0x28, fires sub_401163(0x7A), Sleep(0xA), then reads a batch of self/screen scalars ([0x4db3784],[0x4db372c],[0x4db3728],[0x4db37b4],[0x4db37b0]) and scans the creature array from [0x468f38] in 0xe0 strides ([0x4db37ac] end) for the target; when found it reads that creature's screen box ([0x4db3708]-based +0x30 fields), converts world delta to screen tile via the (x*2-1)<<5 / /0x1e and /0x16 projection math, calls sub_401276 with the computed (sx,sy), Sleep(0xA). Fallback: builds a static frame at [ebp-0x18] (length 0x11, opcode marker 0x83, FF FF, id 2 LE from arg[ebp+8], word fields from arg[ebp+0xc]/[ebp+0x10], stack byte arg[ebp+0x14], and arg[ebp+0x1c]/[ebp+0x20] bytes) and injects via sub_401415. This is the coordinate-projecting 0x83 use-on-map/creature builder.

0x405bd2.name: buildUseOnPositionFrame83
0x405bd2.purpose: Static 0x83 use-on-position builder (no client scan). Frame at [ebp-0x18]: length 0x11, 0x00, marker 0x83, FF FF, then a 0x00 subtype at [ebp-0xe], id 2 LE bytes from arg[ebp+8], a word from arg[ebp+0xc] and a word from arg[ebp+0x10] via the [ebp-0xd] cursor, stack byte from arg[ebp+0x14], a word from arg[ebp+0x18], and a 0x00 count at [ebp-6]. Pushes len 0x18 and the two dst args [ebp+0x1c]/[ebp+0x20], injects via sub_40152D (pipe-target inject). The immediate-coordinate variant of buildUseOnTileOrCreatureFrame83.

0x405c95.name: buildUseOnMappedTileFrame83
0x405c95.purpose: 0x83 use builder that first resolves a floor via the container/map array. Scans base [0x468f38] in 0xe0 strides up to [0x4db37ac], for each entry reads a flag at node-4 (sub_4011B8), passes sub_401370(node) plus arg[ebp+0x14] to sub_44A4D0 (name/tile compare); on a match adds the tile's +0x28/+0x24 offsets to arg[ebp+0xc]/[ebp+0x10] and grabs +0x20 as a z. If no tile matched returns 1. Then subtracts screen-origin scalars [0x4db3728]/[0x4db372c] from the coords and passes them to sub_40143D to map back to a tile node, reads +0x34 from it, and builds the [ebp-0x18] 0x83 frame (length 0x11, marker 0x83, FF FF, id 2 LE from arg[ebp+8], the two coord words, the resolved +0x34 word, subtype bytes) injected via sub_40152D with dst args [ebp+0x18]/[ebp+0x1c]. The tile-lookup variant that resolves a named/mapped tile before emitting the 0x83 frame.

0x405e74.name: buildUseOnContainerFrame83
0x405e74.purpose: Static 0x83 builder addressed to a container slot. Frame at [ebp-0x18]: length 0x11, 0x00, marker 0x83, FF FF, then a byte = arg[ebp+0x1c]+0x40 at [ebp-0x13] (container index biased into the 0x40-0x4F container-address range), 0x00, subtype byte from arg[ebp+0x20], id 2 LE bytes from arg[ebp+8], the same arg[ebp+0x20] byte, then two coord words from arg[ebp+0xc]/[ebp+0x10] via the [ebp-0xd]/[ebp-8] cursors, a stack byte arg[ebp+0x14], a word arg[ebp+0x18], and the arg[ebp+0x24] count. Injects 0x18 bytes via sub_401415 (0x40320a). Emits an 0x83 use frame whose destination is a container (id+0x40) rather than a map tile.

0x40601c.name: buildLookFrame05
0x40601c.purpose: Static builder for opcode 0x05. Frame at [ebp-8]: length 0x05, 0x00, then subtype byte from arg[ebp+0xc] at [ebp-6], then a full 4-byte LE dword from arg[ebp+8] spread across [ebp-5..-2] (all four shift-and-mask bytes). Pushes len 8 plus dst args [ebp+0x10]/[ebp+0x14] and injects via sub_40152D. Wire payload: 05 00 <sub> <val:4 LE> — an 0x05 request frame (look-at / describe by 32-bit id) sent to a specific pipe destination.

0x40608c.name: buildPingFrame14
0x40608c.purpose: Minimal static builder for opcode 0x14. Frame at [ebp-8]: length byte 0x01, 0x00, opcode 0x14 at [ebp-6]; pushes len 8, buffer, sub_401415 (0x40320a inject). No args used. Wire payload: 01 00 14 — a single-byte client keep-alive/ping frame.

0x40a6fb.name: checkTileWalkableAtDelta
0x40a6fb.purpose: Walkability predicate for a single tile at a relative offset. Takes (curX,curY) in [ebp+8]/[ebp+0xc] and origin (refX,refY) in [ebp+0x10]/[ebp+0x14], forms the delta (curX-refX, curY-refY) and resolves the tile record via sub_40143D (tile-address/index resolver). If the resolved record is 0 it returns 0 (out of map). It then walks the client's tile-stack for that cell using the creature/tile stride global [0x468f6c] (record base +0x2c, +8/+4 per item, each field read through sub_4011B8=ReadClientState) and, for each stacked item id (read at record+8), scans the blocking-tile id table at 0x4d2249c (word entries, count [0x46906c]); on a match it returns 0 (blocked). Returns 1 when the cell is walkable. This is the elementary is-blocking-tile test the higher line-scan pathers call.

0x40a7d2.name: scanBlockingTilesOctantA
0x40a7d2.purpose: Line-of-sight / ray blocking-tile scanner over an octant, with debug tracing. Given endpoint (x,y) [ebp+8/0xc], origin (ox,oy) [ebp+0x10/0x14] and screen-offset (sx,sy) [ebp+0x18/0x1c], it interpolates a straight line between origin and endpoint. It picks the major axis by comparing abs(x-ox) vs abs(y-oy) via sub_44ACF5 (integer abs); in the X-major branch it steps the longer axis and computes the minor coordinate with idiv, in the Y-major branch it does the transpose. For each interpolated cell it resolves the tile record with sub_40143D (here offsetting by +[ebp+0x14]-[ebp+0x1c] / +[ebp+0x10]-[ebp+0x18]), formats "[%i,%i]" into the debug buffer 0x4ce9430 via sub_44A6FB(sprintf) + sub_40114F(log/emit), and scans the second blocking-tile id table 0x4d36104 (word entries, count [0x469068]); on the first blocking id it logs "blkingtile %x" and returns 0 (line is blocked). Returns 1 if the whole line is clear. Uses stride global [0x468f6c] to walk each cell's item stack.

0x40ab6e.name: scanBlockingTilesOctantB
0x40ab6e.purpose: Sibling of scanBlockingTilesOctantA (0x40a7d2): same two-phase octant line interpolation (major-axis pick via sub_44ACF5 abs, idiv for the minor axis), same "[%i,%i]" / "blkingtile %x" debug tracing into 0x4ce9430, same blocking-tile table 0x4d36104 (count [0x469068]) and stride [0x468f6c]. Difference: it resolves each interpolated cell through sub_40143D using the raw interpolated (minorCoord, majorCoord) without the screen-offset correction that 0x40a7d2 applies (no +[ebp+0x14]-[ebp+0x1c] adjustment before the tile lookup), i.e. it operates in absolute map coordinates rather than the offset/screen frame. Returns 0 on the first blocking tile hit, 1 if the ray is clear — the map-space variant of the line-blocking check.

0x40aef2.name: isCreatureInThrowRange
0x40aef2.purpose: Predicate: is a given creature present, alive and within throw/cast reach of the player, returning 1 if so. Reads self-target id from guarded self field [0x4db3784] and two self coords from [0x4db372c]/[0x4db3728] (all via sub_4011B8=ReadClientState). Reads three client-side scalars directly from client addresses 0x4b03780/0x4b03782 (2 bytes each) and 0x4b03784 (1 byte) via sub_44A9C0 into locals (a target coordinate pair + a byte flag). It then iterates the client creature array from base [0x468f38] to end [0x4db37ac] in 0xE0-byte strides, reading per-creature fields: id at rec-4, visibility/type at rec+0x20 (must equal the flag byte), an alive/hp field at rec+0x88 (must be >=1), and x/y at rec+0x28 / rec+0x24. It range-checks abs(targetX - creatureX) <= 7 and abs(targetY - creatureY) <= 5 (sub_44ACF5 abs), and on a candidate calls sub_40115E(targetX, targetY, cy, cx, extraA, extraB) — a line/reachability sub-check — returning 1 only if that passes. Excludes the player's own creature (rec == [ebp+8]) and record 0/self [0x4db3784].

0x40b0a3.name: computeLureWalkStep
0x40b0a3.purpose: Cavebot/lure walk-step planner: on a throttle (sub_44A7A8 clock() minus last-tick [0x4db3a84] must exceed interval [0x469058], else return 1) and a gate sub_40145B (returns 1/abort if set), it snapshots self target id [0x4db3784] and self coords from [0x468f34]/[0x4db372c]/[0x4db3728]/[0x468f30]. It selects a walk-mode target value into a local by matching the current mode global [0x4db39a0] against a table of constants (2->[0x468fa4], 0xE->[0x4690e0], 0x13->[0x4db3a10], 0x65->literal 0xc5d, 0x68->[0x4db3a7c]) with extra sub-mode fixups via [0x4db38fc] and a distance read of [0x4db3790]. Dispatches on the direction arg [ebp+8] (-3 = X axis, -4 = Y axis): it scans the creature array [0x468f38]..[0x4db37ac] (0xE0 stride), filtering creatures by id-band (rec-4 vs self id and [0x4db38d0]), a type check sub_401041, target-id match rec+0x20 vs [ebp-0x14], alive rec+0x88, and range windows abs(rec+0x28 - [0x4db3904]) <= 7, abs(rec+0x24 - [0x4db3906]) <= 5. It counts matching monsters against the id/priority tables 0x4d072bc (creature-id list) and 0x4cfd4ec (priority/flag, skips 0x63), computes a centred lure offset from that count (the (count+1)/2 signed arithmetic), clamps the destination to a bounded box (±7 X / ±5 Y around self [ebp-8]/[ebp-0x10]), and builds an 8-entry step array in [ebp-0x68] scaled by the axis sign — the per-tick displacement toward the lure/target position that the walk sender then emits.

0x40cee4.name: runRuneAttackTargeting
0x40cee4.purpose: Rune/attack targeting-and-cast engine (single tick), returns bool. Throttled by sub_44A7A8 clock() vs last-tick [0x4db3aa4] and interval [0x469058]. Snapshots self target id [0x4db3784] and self coords [0x468f30]/[0x4db372c]/[0x4db3728]. It selects a sub-mode from a bank of enable flags: [0x4db3aa0]/[0x4db3a9c]/[0x4db3a98] (single-target rune modes) vs [0x4db3a8c]/[0x4db3a90]/[0x4db3a94] (area/multi modes); returns 0 if none set. In the [0x4db3a8c] branch it follows a target linked-list (sub_401370 dereference, sub_401456 validity, name compare sub_44A590/sub_44A4D0) then scans the creature array [0x468f38]..[0x4db37ac] (0xE0 stride), filtering by id (rec-4 vs self [0x4db3784]), monster type sub_401041, target-id rec+0x20 vs self, alive rec+0x88 vs cap [0x4690f0], and adjacency (abs range via sub_44ACF5). For a chosen creature it selects a rune/spell id (default 0xc50, or [0x468fdc] when a field rec-1 != 0x40) and calls the packet builders sub_4013F2 / sub_401339 to emit the rune-use / attack frame; it also fires the say-path via sub_44A6FB formatting "exura sio \"%s\"" when the heal-self mode [0x4db3a9c] with hp threshold ([0x4db3790] read, >0x46) applies. After sending it Sleep(10) and re-reads the client status-message field [0x468f44] (sub_401370), comparing it (sub_44A4D0) against "You cannot throw there.", "This action is not permitted in a protection zone." and "Destination is out of range."; on none-matched it reports via sub_4010DC (0x469b5c) and on a throw-error resets the throttle [0x4db3aa4]. The [0x4db3a94] branch is a second creature-scan variant with an item-count/priority gate ([0x4690f0], 0x64 cap, [0x469094]). Opcodes are built dynamically inside sub_401339/sub_4013F2, not immediates here.

0x402c73.name: readClientBlockToScratch400
0x402c73.purpose: Thin RPM reader: ReadProcessMemory(handle=[0x4d22464], src=[ebp+8], dst=0x4b28420, size=[ebp+0xc], out=0) copying an arbitrary client-memory block into the local scratch buffer 0x4b28420, then returns the buffer pointer 0x4b28420 in eax. size is caller-supplied ([ebp+0xc]); a raw variant of the ReadClientState band dispatcher with no fixups/caching.

0x402cbb.name: readForegroundClientField
0x402cbb.purpose: Guarded RPM read that only proceeds when the Tibia client window is foreground. GetForegroundWindow; if it equals the tracked client HWND [0x4d22494] it tail-calls ReadClientState-thunk sub_4011B8(addr=[ebp+8], size=[ebp+0xc]) and returns. Otherwise GetWindowTextA(hwnd,buf,0x32) and requires the title's first char == 'T' (0x54, i.e. "Tibia"); if not, returns 0. On match it GetWindowThreadProcessId -> OpenProcess(0x1f0fff PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS, pid), ReadProcessMemory(handle, src=[ebp+8], dst=[ebp-0x40], size=[ebp+0xc]), CloseHandle, returns the 4-byte value read. A focus-gated live client field read used to avoid RPM when the client isn't active.

0x402d4f.name: readContainerCacheOrRpm
0x402d4f.purpose: Container-band accessor for ReadClientState. If clientAddr [ebp+8] falls inside the open-container window (below [0x4db377c]+1 and above container base [0x468f2c]+1) it serves from the parsed local cache: computes offset (addr - [0x468f2c]) + 0x4c1ab74 and memcpy-thunks sub_44A590(dst=0x4b28020, src=cacheAddr) — matching the byte_4C1AB74 container mirror. Otherwise falls back to a direct ReadProcessMemory(handle=[0x4d22464], src=addr, dst=0x4b28020, size=0x400). Returns buffer 0x4b28020.

0x402db5.name: readClientBlock1024ToBuf
0x402db5.purpose: Raw RPM read of 0x400 (1024) bytes from client addr [ebp+8] via ReadProcessMemory(handle=[0x4d22464]) into local buffer 0x4b27c20; returns 0x4b27c20. A fixed-size uncached variant of the ReadClientState raw path (peer of readContainerCacheOrRpm's fallback but always targeting the 0x4b27c20 slot).

0x402ddc.name: readClientBlock128ToBuf
0x402ddc.purpose: Raw RPM read of 0x80 (128) bytes from client addr [ebp+8] via ReadProcessMemory(handle=[0x4d22464]) into local buffer 0x4b27ba0; stores the RPM success flag in [ebp-4] and returns the buffer pointer 0x4b27ba0. Small-record uncached read helper.

0x402e09.name: walkClientMapNodeSumMatch
0x402e09.purpose: Walks a linked structure in the client map/creature mirror by chained ReadClientState-thunk (sub_4011B8, 4-byte reads). Starts from base ptr [0x4db3708], dereferences +0x38 to get a list head, then per node reads: +0x24 (next candidate / child), +0x4, +0x14, +0x18, and accumulator seed at +0x18 into [ebp-8]. Loop: while node[+0x2c] (a key/id) != ([ebp+8]+0x40) it adds node[+0x20] to the running sum [ebp-8] and follows node[+0x10] to the next node; on match returns the accumulated sum [ebp-8]. Returns -0xc8 (0xffffff38) if the list runs out. Computes a cumulative offset/position for the id passed in [ebp+8] (a red-black/ordered tree walk summing left-subtree sizes — an index-of computation).

0x402ee4.name: walkClientMapNodeSumMatchInclusive
0x402ee4.purpose: Near-identical twin of walkClientMapNodeSumMatch (0x402e09): same [0x4db3708]->+0x38 tree base and same per-node field reads (+0x24,+0x4,+0x14,+0x18, key +0x2c vs [ebp+8]+0x40). Difference: on the matching node it also adds node[+0x20] to the sum before returning (inclusive index), and the non-match branch adds node[+0x20] then follows node[+0x10]. Returns 0xffffff38 (-0xc8) on exhaustion. The inclusive-rank counterpart used to size/position an element within the ordered client structure.

0x402fd8.name: copyClientTreeLeafField
0x402fd8.purpose: Navigates the [0x4db3708] client tree two levels deep by 4-byte ReadClientState reads: base+0x40 -> node, node+0x40 -> node2, node2+0x2c -> node3, node3+0x2c -> leaf value [ebp-4]. Passes node3 (at +0x2c depth) twice through sub_401253 (a pointer/accessor transform) and memcpy-thunks the result via sub_44A590 into the fixed global slot 0x4d7d6d4. Always returns 1. Publishes a resolved client-object field into the local mirror slot 0x4d7d6d4.

0x4030f5.name: invokeMapCallbackIfSet
0x4030f5.purpose: Guarded callback dispatch: loads handler pointer [0x4db3940]; if non-null, calls sub_4013BB(handler, arg=[ebp+8]) then calls sub_44A7A8 and stores its return into [0x4db393c]. Fires a registered map/state callback with a single argument and records the result token. [0x4db3940] = callback slot, [0x4db393c] = last-result slot.

0x403181.name: readClientByteAtBase
0x403181.purpose: Reads a single byte (size=1) from the client via ReadClientState-thunk sub_4011B8(addr=[0x468f10], 1) and returns it. [0x468f10] is a resolved client base/field address; a 1-byte accessor (likely a status/flag field such as connection or a map-header byte).

0x40319f.name: findNthActiveContainerSlot
0x40319f.purpose: Scans the open-container table by fixed 0x1ec (492-byte) stride — matching the documented 492-byte-per-container container mirror. Iterates slot cursor from container base [0x468f2c], stepping +0x1ec until it reaches the window end [0x4db377c]. For each slot reads the 'active/open' flag at slot+0x34 via ReadClientState (sub_4011B8, size 4); each active slot increments a found-counter, and when the counter matches the requested index [ebp+8] (decremented per active slot until < 0) returns that slot's zero-based ordinal [ebp-4]. Maps a logical container index to the Nth open physical container slot; returns -1 if not found.

0x403574.name: sendPipeXteaFrame
0x403574.purpose: XTEA-encrypts a frame and sends it over a socket. Guards on [0x4b27b9c]: if already 0x63 (busy) Sleep(1) and abort, else sets it 0x63. Debug-prints "Sending pipeSP:" and each byte via sub_40114F/" %X ". Runs the standard Tibia XTEA encrypt loop in 8-byte blocks (delta 0x61c88647 used as -sum step, 32 rounds, key = [ebp+0x10] 4-dword key schedule) over payload [ebp+8] length [ebp+0xc]. Prepends a 2-byte little-endian length header ([ebp-0x200/-0x1ff]) via sub_44A9C0, then send()s (buf, len+2, socket=[ebp+0x14]). Clears busy flag [0x4b27b9c]=0, returns 1. This is the encrypted socket-send path (distinct from the plaintext pipe injector 0x40320a).

0x4037de.name: latchWalkStepGlobal
0x4037de.purpose: Copies dword [0x46902c] into [0x4b07b8c] and returns. Snapshots a config/global (a walk-step or timing value at [0x46902c]) into a working slot [0x4b07b8c] used elsewhere in the walk/record engine.

0x4037ed.name: recordAndReplayActionPacket
0x4037ed.purpose: Large action-record/replay + auto-walk router for captured client packets. Early-out returns 1 unless one of the recorder/bound enable flags is set ([0x4db3950],[0x4db38f8],[0x4db38e0],[0x4db3954],[0x4db3958]). Deobfuscates the incoming packet: sub_4012BC then XTEA-decrypt (delta 0x61c88647, sum seed 0xc6ef3720, 32 rounds, key from [0x468f08]+0/4/8/0xc) over a copy in [ebp-0x9c], length ([ebp+8] field -4, bounded 0..0x28). Debug-dumps bytes (" %X ","----") via sub_40114F. If record mode [0x4db398c]==1 and first byte != 0x1e it prints "Action Recorded", copies the packet into the recording table [0x4db3964]<<8 + 0x4b17b9c and increments record index [0x4db3964]. Then a two-point map-bound capture state machine on [0x4db3970] keyed to packet signature (byte0==0x83, byte6==0x21, byte7==1): stage 1 stores 5 bytes to 0x4b07b90 and prints "Set 2nd Bound"; stage 3 computes dx/dy via abs-thunk sub_44ACF5 between the two captured coords ([ebp-0xec]/[ebp-0xdc] vs [ebp-0xd8]/[ebp-0xe0]), decides walk axis, memsets a 0x60 path buffer 0x4b07b2c, and iterates candidate steps calling sub_4010D2 (walkability/step test) using client fields [0x4db372c]/[0x4db3728], writing chosen coords to path slots 0x4b03780/82/84. Builds recorded-walk paths from captured movement packets.

0x404ad5.purpose: Assembles an 8-byte control frame on the stack: byte0=1, byte1=0, byte2 = ([ebp+8] & 0xff) (an opcode/subtype), then hands the 8-byte buffer to the frame emitter sub_40152D(buf, len=8, [ebp+0xc], [ebp+0x10]) (the two extra args are forwarded to the sender/inject path). Returns 1. A short fixed-shape command builder (1-byte-opcode + control-code frame).

0x404b0d.name: sendMapClickWalkOrUse
0x404b0d.purpose: Master-flag-gated ([0x469098]==1) map-interaction/use builder. First scans the creature/tile array in the client mirror: cursor from [0x4db373c] stepping +0x100, up to base+0xb00, translating each via sub_401370 and comparing to arg [ebp+8] with sub_44A4D0; when a slot matches and its per-slot flags ([0x4db3734]+i byte==1 via ReadClientState, [0x4db3738]+i*4 ==0) it calls sub_401163(i+0x70) and returns. If no live match it zeroes [0x4db3738]+0x28, copies arg into [0x4db373c]+0xa00 (sub_4010AA), sets [0x4db3734]+0xa flag and calls sub_401163(0x7a) (opcode 0x7A path). Otherwise treats [ebp+8] as a coordinate/id: sub_44A680(arg)+4 -> value bounded (==4 or <=0x80), packs it as a 2-byte little-endian field plus constant tag bytes 0x96,0x01 into frame [ebp-0x80..], appends a second decremented 2-byte value, memcpys arg via sub_44A590, computes a bit-length (rounded /8) and calls sub_401415 (the inject thunk -> 0x40320a) to send the frame. Builds and injects a use/walk-to interaction packet from a creature-array lookup.

0x402046.name: findClientPidByModuleName
